notes.title: Update 1.20.0 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

1.20.0 is finally here with some big new features!

With this update we have added the Skin & Dye system, which currently offers 2 unlockable skins for each class, and 8 unique dyes for each class - 4 of which are unlocked from the start. We plan to expand on this system with more skins and dyes being added in the future, too!

Tinka's Domain also got a makeover and is now much larger and has some space reserved for Secret Future Things, as well as having a brand new soundtrack that makes it a very atmospheric place to hang out and theorycraft :-)

Speaking of theorycrafting - several sets have been buffed and many items and runes got tweaked, changed, and a few even got replaced with something more suitable (or usable). There's also a few new items and runes for you to discover!

There's also a new Death Recap system, which is a log of what happened to your character before it died, which you can read to figure out what defenses you may need to improve etc.

Along with that comes also a bunch of QoL improvements and fixes, such as being able to lower the amount of particles from spells & effects, always loading in to the last visited hub (Chronicon or Tinka's) when loading up your character, and more.

Last but not least, Endless Tier Boosting is now adaptive and will let you boost more tiers the further you get, up to a maximum of 10 tiers per run!


And now we begin work on the first DLC which will expand upon the endgame content quite a bit. We will have more info to share as things progress, but you can refer to the roadmap to see the overall plans for the rest of the year.

And as you may have noticed, this text is full of "we" and not "I" - that's because as of a few months ago, my fiancée has officially joined Subworld and the development of Chronicon! She's been with us the entire way since before the Early Access launch in 2015, giving me feedback and painstakingly helping me test things. And as of this year she's been taking on larger responsibilities like world & system design! We've worked on some pretty cool things lately, which you'll see in the first DLC, later this year! I'll remain the outward voice but you'll probably see her pop up on the forums or in support email from time to time under the nickname "Marruu". Yes, the same as Commander Marruu from Act  2 :-) 

Anyway, please give her a warm welcome!


And, as always, thank you for the bug reports, suggestions, comments, and fun discussions!

That's all for now, I hope you enjoy the update!

https://youtu.be/688oCpiPnXo

Here are the full notes of this update:

1.20.0
Big Features:

New Tinka's Domain! Complete with a brand new music track for it.
Added Skin & Dye system (Wardrobe) - access it by interacting with the new red Wardrobe in Tinka's Domain or The Chronicon (near your stash).
Added 2 additional skins for each class, unlockable via story and endgame progression on a per-class basis (account-wide unlock).
Added 32 dyes: 8 per class - 4 base dyes that are always available, and 4 dyes that drop from bosses randomly (account-wide unlock).
Note: Your character is no longer automatically dyed based on skill point distribution - the new dye system overwrites this! But the base 4 dyes are very similar to the old system.
Added a Death Recap system! Click the new Death Recap button after you've died to see the last 25 changes to your health, including detailed information such as damage element, direct/indirect, absorbs, healing, and more.

Linux:

Now (finally) up to date!

Endgame Improvements:

For every 50 Endless Tiers beaten, the Boost Tier boosts and additional Tier, ie at T50 you can boost 4 at a time, at 100 5 at a time, etc. Caps at 10 at a time.

QoL Stuff:

Stash and Dummies are now marked on map in both Tinka's Domain and the Chronicon.
Tinka's Domain and The Chronicon maps no longer gets fogged up (always fully explored).
Loading a character now puts you in your last visited hub (Tinka's Domain or The Chronicon) rather than always in The Chronicon.
Added a new scale setting for the item, spell, and tooltip cards. (so it can be scaled independently from your inventory scale setting)
Runes now have a prefix depending on if they are crafted or found in Anomalies. This prefix is also noted (and shortened) when hovering over an item with a Rune on it.
Added a "Particle Intensity" setting to the Video options, which can be lowered or even turned off to reduce particle clutter.
Items that have been dropped out of the inventory no longer get picked back up with radial loot, and must be individually picked up.
Made in-game update notes (from 1.20 and forwards) more readable.

Items & Enchants:

Enchants:

Poison Satellites: Now deal instant damage as well as the DoT effect. Now works with Entity's Eccentricity.
Twisters: Lasts slightly shorter, performance improved.
Crit Explode: Slight performance bump.

Any Class:

Jotunhelm: Now GA to 60% (was 50%).
Lucilla's Vision: Now GA to 16% (was 15%).
The Hardcore: Now has a cooldown of 90 seconds, down from 180.
Cosmic Cape: Now turns 1.5x of the Mana into Damage, down from 2x.
Stormchasers: Now Greater Augments up to 20% (was 15%) but has a cap of 15 stacks.

Templar:

(New) Heatwall: Molten Shield and Shattering Shield have x% less cooldown and deals x% increased damage, and also casts Singe.
Vindicator: Now also applies a debuff to foes hit, increasing the damage they take from the effect. Stacks infinitely.
Tome of Healing: Now always rolls Increased Healing From All Sources instead of Health Regeneration.
Tome of Condemnation: The Ember cast on Condemnation now deals the same damage as Condemnation did.
Iactus: Now gives Shield Throw, Shield Spiral, and Shield Boomerang a chance on hit to cast Shield Spiral.

Berserker:

Brutal Stompers now affect Hop (utility).
Cataclysm set: 3) Stalagmites instead form in a nova around the Berserker, releasing after 2 seconds to deal 300% of the total built up damage of all Stalagmites. Each hit of Quake increases the damage the Stalagmite nova deals by 15% to that target.

Warlock:

Coldhearted Lich 2) now also doubles the base damage of Spirit of Torment.


Runes:

Note:

All classes now have 20 runes each, with 20 general runes applicable to all classes, giving a total of 100 runes!

Any Class:

Lesser Rune of Companion Mobility now grants all companions the Warping affix (Leaping affix is not granted to Melee companions anymore).

Templar:

(New) Lesser Rune of Blocking: Can be placed on weapons and offhands, and makes the item count as a shield as well as grant block chance/damage.
(New) Lesser Rune of Rolling Thunder has been replaced with Rune of Magnetic Flurry: While Flurry is active in a slot, Magnetic Blades, Magnetic Orbs, and Magnetic Field tick rate is increased by x% of attack speed.
(New) Lesser Rune of Molten Fragmentations: Molten Fragmentations is now a Nova skill and deals x% increased damage in all directions. 
(New) Lesser Rune of Blade Celerity: Each trigger of Celerity summons a single Dancing Blade which lasts 7 seconds. Max Y blades can be summoned form this effect.
The old effect of Lesser Rune of Rolling Thunder has been moved to the Sword called Rolling Thunder.

Berserker:

Lesser Rune of Mega Charge: now increases damage by an additional 30/50% (A/GA), up from 18/25%.
Lesser Rune of Dragon Thorn: now deals 500/800% (A/GA) Thorn damage, up from 220/300%.
Lesser Rune of Pulverize: Stonefist now always strike 3 additional times on Crowned foes, and now augments increased damage over extra strikes. Augments up to 200% increase in damage.

Warden:

Lesser Rune of Poison Trees: now augments 200/300% down from 300/500%.
Lesser Rune of Norla's Gale: Now makes Gusts and Tornadoes aim for the Warden's target, and any Tornadoes cast beyond the cap will empower existing Tornadoes and refresh their duration.
(New) Lesser rune of The Storm Killer: When Razor Wind is cast on a Tornado, the Tornado explodes for xxx% of its total remaining damage in a 5 meter radius.

Warlock:

(New) Lesser Rune of Ritual of Desecration: While Ritual of Souls is active in a slot, Desecration deals xxx% increased damage. (Replaces Rune of Curse of Thorns which previously did absolutely nothing... my bad)
(New) Lesser Rune of Demonkin: While there is a living Infernal Demon, Demon Spawn (Ultimate) is active.
(New) Lesser Rune of Perforation: Ritual of Perforation also increases the damage of all Projectile skills by xxx%.
(New) Lesser Rune of Mega Horde: Horde is xxx% more effective.
Lesser Rune of Infinite Ruin: Now also causes foes affected by Ruin to suffer xxx% increased damage from Cold Death.


Skills:

Berserker:

Leap, Arctic Leap, Dragon Leap: Lowered screenshake.
Freezing Breath: Lowered visual clutter, increased chance to freeze to ground to 28/46/64/82/100% (was 18/21/24/27/30%)
Distant Threat (mastery): No longer targets far away foes, and instead prioritizes targeting Crowned foes. Now called "Immediate Threat".

Warden:

Sprint is now also a Mobility skill. (was only Utility)
Chain Lightning: No longer has a cooldown, and is now an Assault skill.
Sporelings: No longer deals damage when passing through foes - only boosts shrooms. No longer spawns when too many spores are on-screen, and will instead immediately boost a nearby shroom.
Windwalker: No longer has a visual effect when using Norla's Gale.
Gale: Is now 30% smaller (visual only).
Tornado: Is now limited to 5 instances. Is now 10% smaller (visual only).


Performance:

Improved overall performance somewhat.
Slightly improved some Anomaly load times.
Post-processing shaders (bloom, heat effect, water/lava movement etc) performance boosted by approx 10%.

Sound & Speech:

Added new sound & speech to Stamm the Unbreakable act 2 boss.
Added closing sounds for both Stashes and the Wardrobe.

Misc:

The stash now has an open and close visual indication.

Fixes:

Lantern Trees in Act 2 and Anomalies are back to being colorful.
The Star markings on base item stats should now correctly consider weapon attack speed when marking the damage stat.
Fixed issue in co-op where creating a new character as the last joined player would reset quest progress for the other characters.
Fixed the gamepad button prompts overlapping the Buyback notice on shops when using a controller.
Fixed issue where effects that made Ultimate skills last until death could be exploited to cast said ultimate and swap it to something else and still maintain it and another Ultimate (or other skill).
Fixed issue which would cause lava to not light up properly when using custom or mis-matched resolution settings.
Fixed multiple issues with text and button scaling in menus when using certain 4:3 resolutions.
Fixed issue where on some resolutions the skill tree and inventory were not the same size and had some weird visual errors.
Fixed Potions not displaying the minimum level to drink.
Fixed Chantie's and Chantelle's voice lines sometimes getting mixed up.
Fixed crash from using Warden's Life Roots Perk.
Fixed hover names on Stash etc being displayed after clicking it.
Fixed issue where last bosses of acts 4 and 5 didn't give enough loot.
Fixed some missing localization such as companion names & tags.
Fixed several issues with help index in localized files.
Fixed crash from generating Champions with bad or missing name data (custom translations are typically the cause of this!)
Fixed crash from Frost Blitz enemy affix that could occur if an icicle spawned on the same frame the enemy was cleared from memory.

notes.title: Update 1.11.1 - stash fix
notes.notes:
This update fixes the stash issues reported - thanks for the reports!

Let me know if any issues persist.


1.11.1:
Hotfix:

Fixed not being able to buy stash tabs/rows, and some minor visual glitches in the shared stash.

notes.title: Update 1.11.0 is live with fixes, tweaks, and Spanish language!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update mainly focuses on fixing issues and improving QoL, but it also adds the second official translation: Spanish!

If you play with click-to-move I think you will find that it's much more responsive, and I'd love to get your feedback on the changes. I've also changed the item cards when you hover items on the ground to be the same as the one you see in the inventory, and I've moved it to the bottom right corner so it doesn't obscure your vision in fights.

Aside from that, a bunch of recent and old issues alike have been fixed. Some were hard to reproduce and confirm so please let me know if any issue persists and I will get back on that!

Next big update will be 1.20 - check out the roadmap here for more info on the coming updates!

Thanks! 

1.11.0:
Language:

Added Official Spanish translation!

Controls:

Click-to-move controls have been greatly improved to be more responsive.
Players 2-4 in co-op can now use the Autoloot feature.

Interface:

Slight performance bump for some interface elements.
Hovering an item on the ground with the cursor (or holding the inspect button on a controller) now shows the item info as it does in the inventory.

Items:

Jeopardy no longer rolls Crit Explode, and instead rolls Enrage as the extra enchant.

Misc:

Improved text file data printouts for 3rd party tools. (ctrl+S+J now prints ALL currently available data, and it makes the game unresponsive meanwhile because reasons)

Fixes:

Fixed some parts of Act 2 being able to spawn Shrines that blocked the path.
Fixed pathfinding not being updated when doors were locked or unlocked (opened/closed), giving problems to AI, companions, and click-to-move.
Fixed several inconsistencies and issues with click-to-move controls which could lead to the player getting stuck.
Fixed Ancestral Rage rune (Berserker) causing Frostskin to give absurd amounts of resistance.
Fixed Warden Perk "Flutterwarm" giving inconsistent and sometimes increasing amounts of Evasion when changing equipment.
Fixed Greater Rune count not going down (nor the effect being removed from the player) when using Runelord's Remorse on an equipped item.
Fixed the "Music Frequency" setting resetting itself after a game restart.
Fixed Radial Loot circle remaining after disabling the Auto-loot option from the settings.
Fixed Expulsion + Soul Purge not giving correct damage numbers (visual only).
Fixed issue where player clothing colors would revert to the base color after editing skills.
Fixed Stone of Tephra not being marked as being from a Unique foe in the Codex.
Fixed incorrect highlighting in the Shared Stash when having unlockable rows in the Personal Stash.
Fixed some text remaining in English (or whatever language was active on game start) when changing the language.
Fixed Mastery skill descriptions sometimes missing skill references (blank names).
Fixed some hotkey prompts showing keyboard keys when using a controller.
Fixed issue where you wouldn't get the "press (X) to inspect" tooltip while in your inventory using a controller.
Fixed some font overlap issues when having longer hotkey tooltips.
Fixed the single-use portal from The Roost to The Lushlands (Act 4) remaining after usage and causing a crash if used a second time.
Fixed graveyard crash when having some bad data.
Potential fix for weird crash that may happen on kill-X-amount-of-Y side quests - hard to reproduce, please let me know if it persists!
Potential fix for several co-op issues such as random freezing when rapidly selling stuff at a vendor and waypoint issues.

notes.title: Update 1.10.8 is live with fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!


Another bugfix update has just gone live, fixing the remaining reported crashes and some other issues as of the recent large update. This update also lets you radial loot the event gifts!

Thanks for all the reports, and as always please let me know if any issues persist!

Thanks!

1.10.8:
Fixes:

Fixed crash on certain optional quests that required kills of special types of monsters, such as Storms on the Horizon.
Fixed crash upon entering The Badlands.
Fixed not being able to import builds.
Fixed not being able to pickup the special Holiday Gifts with radial loot.
Fixed issue where renaming a character would cause a crash if returning to main menu and hitting "Continue as ".
Fixed renamed characters not immediately showing up in the Load Hero menu.
Fixed possible duplicate entries into the Graveyard of killed Hardcore characters.
Fixed some skill and helpfile typos.
Fixed Captain Moore (and some other enemies) getting stuck in animation.

notes.title: Update 1.10.7 - fixes for recent crashing
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The most recent update introduced a few issues which should hopefully be resolved now.
Unfortunately I had to temporarily remove some effects of a few berserker skills to stop the crashing, but they will be back as soon as I can make it work again. A new engine update sometimes introduces new issues that can be hard to pin down, so if you get any weird behavior or crashes, please let me know, and I will get right on it!

Thank you!

1.10.7:
Fixes:

Fixed crash on triggering the Act 5 gate cutscene.
Fixed Overload not breaking objects.
Fixed Arc Punch, Overload, Lightning Fist, and Shattering Punch causing a crash.
Note: They no longer fire off projectiles/lightning - this will be added back.

notes.title: Update 1.10.6 is live - fixes, tweaks, and performance
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Update 1.10.6 is now live with fixes for recent issues, as well as some general tweaks and performance increases.

Notably, the game is now also 64-bit! 
If you are running an older 32-bit system, you can find a 32-bit version in the BETA branches on steam, but please be aware that 32-bit will not be supported indefinitely.

Linux users: 1.10.6 will be rolled out to Linux systems sometime later, as we are having some problems compiling in the latest engine version. I hope this will not delay us too much.


A time-limited Christmas event will go live on December 15th, so keep an eye out for that!
During this event you'll find extra loot - as neatly wrapped gifts! You'll also be able to visit a special location, and you'll find that the denizens of the word of Chronicon has decorated for the season. More info coming on the 15th!

Here are the full notes:

1.10.6 (includes changes for the 1.10.5 test build)
Note:

The game is now 64-bit! There is a 32-bit version available in the BETA branches on Steam if your system does not support it.

Changes:

Improved performance.
Improved in-game text presentation.
Improved color coding of endgame rewards listing.
Changing equipment now triggers a full companion and buff clear, to prevent some snapshotting abuse.
Added visual effect to Meteora (Warlock TL).
Vestige of Lost Souls now only applies the barrier and drains the mana if the new barrier would be stronger than the current one.
When triggering Expulsion via the synergy node, the Expulsion effect is now fire-colored.

Fixes:

Fixed loading screens repeatedly saying "Preparing..."
Fixed several issues with Japanese fonts, text, and automatic card resizing.
Fixed some minor placement issues with Chinese text.
Fixed some more grammar problems in skill descriptions.
Fixed Caine's set incorrectly referencing Blaze duration instead of Flare duration for the 3p bonus.
Fixed some sound loop problems.
Fixed Rime dealing too low damage.
Fixed Jagged Rocks proccing even with 0 investment into the skill.
Fixed minimap player position offset when having the clock enabled.
Fixed crash related to Tornado sounds.
Fixed crash when resetting a zone after changing difficulty.
Fixed Boots of Hazard crash.

notes.title: Post-release Roadmap!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I have now created a roadmap with the major parts of my plans for Chronicon for the next year. You can read all about it on the forums, here.

I hope this answers your questions about the continued support of Chronicon!

Thanks!

notes.title: Update 1.10.4 is live - fixes and tweaks
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for your continued reports and suggestions!

Here's an update that takes care of some recent issues.

1.10.4:
Mechanics & Progression:

Changed how mastery experience is calculated past really high levels (3500+).
Resetting skills/masteries, importing builds, and hot-swapping any skill or mastery now clears all effects to prevent snapshotting abuse.
Slightly changed how Wings of Sziirk works to try and prevent getting stuck in walls.
The stat "Increased Healing From All Sources" no longer has diminishing returns.
Added some extra checks to determine whether or not to trigger When Moving and When Still type effects, such as the Warden's Careful Aim.

Monsters:

Lowered damage of Razor Wind when cast by enemies like Gazer.
Quaker, Slamcross, Trapper, and Frostblitz enemy affixes are now considered ground effects.
Arrow Hail, when used by enemies, now have a longer delay, duration, and drop the arrows much slower.

Misc:

Adjusted some overlapping buttons in the interface when using gamepad.
Added some tweaks to the load/verification system to be less strict and be able to recreate some missing data when necessary.

Locale:

Updated Chinese locale.
Possible fix for poor formatting of Japanese text.

Linux:

Possible fix for weird mouse snapping / getting stuck on multiple monitor setups. Side effect: mouse will not be confined to window at all.
Possible fix for "continue as ..." button not working properly.

Fixes:

Fixed Cosmic Cape resetting mana weirdly.
Fixed incorrect values (visual only) on the Furious Retaliation set bonuses.
Fixed runes made of Heart of The Community not fitting any items.
Fixed renamed characters not appearing on Load Hero menu until after a game restart.
Fixed Continue button not working after renaming the last played character.
Fixed Banished Evil templar mastery perk not working correctly with Crown of Innate Probability.
Fixed Soul Avatars not correctly interacting with Mightcap.
Fixed Carriers (Perk) not working when manually killing Plague Bearers.
Fixed issue where Holy Fire was snapshotting incorrectly, and when in combination with Blazing Hammers, not triggering Mana/Health on Hit correctly.
Fixed Prayer Beads and Judges Gavel not working with Holy Fire and Lesser Rune of Blazing Hammers.
Fixed Blood Curse and Flesh Rot, when cast by enemies, bypassing poison immunity.
Fixed Wisps not targeting the players target with the Wispmother set.
Fixed automatic backups being made for builds/keybinds/filters even though they don't actually use the backup system.
Fixed Crafting Materials showing a level requirement.
Fixed Act 3 tombs not being considered boss rooms, letting you get locked out if you die.
Fixed Frostblitz enemy affix not dealing damage.
Fixed crash related to loading characters.
Fixed GUI clock using single digits to display single minutes/hours.
Fixed Wolfcaster Rune not working with the Frostburn passive.
Fixed Chantie using Chantelle's voice line when re-locking an unlocked enchant that was at maximum Greater Augment cap.
Fixed issue with endlessly "loading" characters on Load Hero screen.

notes.title: Update 1.10.2 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've had some issues with Anti-Virus flagging the game as kinda sus, so this update will hopefully fix that! From testing, it was most likely related to clearing out some old data, which was caught as a suspicious action.

Also, if you had issues with your characters not showing up on the Load Hero menu, this update should also fix this - if this issue persists, please send a screenshot of the load menu along with your save files to help@subworldgames.com and I will investigate further. Note: your save data is not lost, the game is just not recognizing it for some players, so do not worry!

Anyway, I'm sorry for the inconvenience this might have caused, and I think you for being understanding and helping me test and verify the issues!


Here are the full notes for the fixes deployed since 1.10.0:

1.10.2:
Fixes:

Rolled back engine version to hopefully clear false positive AV alerts.
Fixed issue where some saves were ignored and not loaded with the new save/load system.
Fixed newly created characters not appearing in the Load Hero menu until after a game restart.
Fixed inventory not visually updating after gambling with a controller.
Fixed not being able to close the popup on Graveyard graves with a controller.



1.10.1:
Fixes:

Fixed crash when Shady Dealer spawned.
Fixed Heart of the Community not being added to Codex.
Fixed class bio on creating a new character always showing the Templar's bio.
Fixed characters that had been saved incorrectly before not being able to be fixed/loaded.
Fixed issue where repeated entrance into the Pumpkin Field would not correctly spawn enemies.
Fixed issue where sometimes re-entering an area would clear it of monsters and move portals.
Fixed an infinite loop in the Hidden Cellar event in Act 3.
Fixed rare issue where creating a new character could reset your essences.

notes.title: Update 1.10.0 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Update 1.10.0 is now live!

This update features a revamped difficulty for the Story, a new backup system for your saves, improved Anomalies, a tier skip for the Endless Anomalies, some new Transmutation recipes - and much more!

Originally I was planning even more things for this update, however I decided to split it into two, so expect another update of similar size some time later. Planned features for the next update include build balance/buffs, and unlockable character skins!

Also, if you are not yet on the Discord, please join!
We are currently taking a vote on the first DLC!

I hope you enjoy!

Here's the full notes:
1.10.0:
Anomalies:

Added a tier skip feature to Endless tiers, where you can spend crystals to enter a special Endless Dungeon Anomaly that advances you 3 tiers when completed, but boots you if you die.
Added some more Anomaly boss fight rooms.
Improved Anomaly boss intros (they are now skipable).
Added a new Crater anomaly layout that is smaller and has more variation.
Added a new Forest layout for anomalies.
Gave the Space Forest anomalies a new base layout.
Removed the "Lushlands" layout from the Space Forest tileset because the water and ground were too similar.
Removed the pointy dead ends of Hellfort anomalies.

Backup system:

Added an automatic backup system that now keeps up to 2 rolling backups of all your characters, stash, progression, etc. files.
This system automatically checks for save failures and corruptions, and will automatically restore backups if any problem is found.

Difficulty & Mechanics:

Added some experimental anti-snapshot changes, destroying any active spell when changing equipment.
Adjusted damage scaling of non-boss enemy attacks granted via random affixes.
Added a slight delay to Eruption and Poison Bomb enemy affixes.
Increased movement speed of all enemies.
Increased enemy damage scaling on Epic and Legendary difficulties.
Increased enemy health scaling from Heroic to Mythic 2.
Increased base movement speed of players by 25%.
Movement speed enchants lowered accordingly to give approx the same theoretical max speed.
Staggered damage now has a base 30% damage reduction to the staggered ticks (the effect that previously was on Balgar's Binding).
Changed how enchant values are rolled on items - they are no longer weighted towards the max roll, and are now more evenly spread between min and max.
Tweaked the growth of Bonus Crystals stat and the Memory Essence rewards in the Endless Anomalies.
Anomaly bosses should now be recognized as bosses for effects such as Mantle of The Dragonkin.
Increased Dummy health so maybe you guys don't explode them.
Increased maximum buff stacks of infinite stacking buffs (most would cap at 9.9k stacks before, I assumed no one would have the patience to reach that - I was wrong)
Removed ultimate skill player skin changes, in preparation for a new permanent skin system - coming soon. (unlockable skins!)
Removed item Power stat (was misleading).
Shady Dealer no longer sells unlimited amounts of boxes, but are more likely to have boxes in stock.

Hardcore:

Graveyard graves now show the Endless Tier reached on dead heroes (that died after this update).

Transmutation:

Added new Transmutation recipes:

Destroy Rune
Destroy Prismatic Socket
Random True Legendary
Random Lesser Rune

More Transmutation recipes are now known from the start, making it easier to figure out how Transmutation works.
Transmutation no longer automatically fails when an item marked as Favorite is involved, but will now fail when *equipment* marked as Favorite is *consumed* in the transmutation.
Transmutation will now tell you if it fails because of a Favorited item.

Items & Skills:

General:

Added a new Major enchant: Increased Healing from all sources. Can be rolled on Helmet, Armor, and Boots.
Added new item: Heart of The Community, granted to all new characters.
Added new item: Cosmic Cape (TL accessory): Turns x% of Mana into Damage.
Added two new rare crafting materials: Runelord's Remorse and Prismatic Liquid.
Indirect Chain Lightning on hit enchants/gems now have a 25% trigger rate, up from 15%.
Jeopardy (TL Ring) no longer has an ICD, but is limited to 1 stack per frame.
Tome of Knowledge is now called Chronicle of Knowledge to not be confused for a Tome (off-hand item).
Advancing Army buffed to 330/430 A/GA to compensate lowered movement speed enchant values.
Battle Boots and Lesser Rune of Lethal Mobility now trigger before other effects, letting them interact with skill-specific effects, such as Lesser Rune of Acrobatic Barrage.
Mightcap now also increases the strength of all Ultimate skills.
Balgar's Binding no longer reduces damage taken from staggered damage, and increases damage by up to 25% of held Staggered Damage (buffed from 20%).

Templar:

Divine Link (ring) now increases healing from all sources by up to 200% (GA).
Thorn Orbs mastery is now affected by Satellite Strength.
Purged Through Holy Flames (synergy skill) is now affected by mastery proc rate increment passives.

Berserker:

Lesser Rune of The Blue Bolt now also affects Hop.
Molten Medallion now adds damage per 22 MPR, up from per 33 MPR.
Cooling Off is now affected by the Blizzards Mastery (+Frost Winds Proc Rate).
Earth and Sky and Dragon's Might (synergy skills) are now affected by mastery proc rate increment passives.
Berserker synergy passives no longer chain together.
Increased the Hitbox size for Thunder Punch.
Increased range of Lightning Fist to 5.5/6/6.5/7/7.5, was 5.3/5.6/5.9/6.2/6.5 meters. Also increased projectile speed.
Dragmageddon is no longer a Sentry skill.

Warden:

Life Link now heals for 1% of max HP per hit.
Volley no longer have diminishing returns on damage.
Storm Mender use effect is now affected by Companion Passive and Use Effect stat.

Warlock:

The Masochist 2p bonus is now reflected in tooltips and interact with bonuses towards the affected skills properly (such as Bone Skill Damage).
Icecrown satellite spears now target the player's target.
The Bone Spear (staff) is now reflected in tooltips and interact with bonuses towards Bone Spear properly (such as Bone Skill Damage).
Reduced the effect of Death Knight (ulti) to 20%, down from 30%.
Ruin will now deal damage correctly within the listed range on the tooltip.


General QoL stuff:

You can now change difficulty by talking to Tinka.
Items now use silver stars to reflect if their base stats are at max value for their rarity, and gold stars if they are at max possible value (TL and/or empowered to max).
Navigating the waypoint with a gamepad now wraps around, so you can go upwards to get to the bottom quick.
Rare loot effects (shines) are now always drawn on top, showing the items clearly when behind walls and such.
Clarified some item, rune, and enchant descriptions.
Ancient Sickle (Halloween Event quest item) is now Unique, so it appears on your map when dropped.

Interface:

Added support for Japanese community translations. (Please let me know if there are problems presenting the text or if something is missing!)
Added a small tutorial when opening the endgame interface for the first time.
Added map cycle options to the interface menu (all on by default).
Added more "short number" letters so it doesn't break when you pass Q.
Stat page (not the inventory quick reference) now also show uncapped values on resistances.
Minimap and area info is now transparent like the quest tracker.
Added a HUD clock (can be toggled on/off in interface settings).
Added a cursor color setting to interface settings.
Improved locale support by adding a "suffix only" mode for enemies and items, solving problems with gendered words for some languages.
Improved difficulty select menu (performance, text placement, added notice on being able to change later).
FPS display now scales with HUD scale.
Made several improvements to text handling, please let me know if you spot any oddities.

Performance:

Improved performance of HUD updates.
Improved performance of damage numbers displays and updates.
Improved performance of static light rendering like torches, lanterns, etc.
Experimental change to tile handling that may improve overall performance, mostly noticable on lower end hardware.
Improved texture handling.

Fixes:

Changed how the "Trapped!" quest works so it now spawns the Unique foe with the Zombies, and killing it is the trigger to complete the quest, event, and unlock the door. Should prevent future lockouts.
Fixed issue where changing language did not update fully until after a game restart.
Fixed Revert and Magnetic Lock not having damage listed on the tooltip.
Fixed issue where stash changes might not be saved if you quit to menu too fast after accessing the stash or if your character saves super fast following a stash access.
Fixed poor performance during new character creation.
Fixed some setting buttons being out of place and not in order when using controller.
Fixed issue where disconnecting a controller might not let you use the keyboard again.
Fixed issue where you could get softlocked if a controller disconnected when your character died.
Fixed some issues with "click-throughs" on menus with a controller.
Fixed weird crash from the endgame waypoint when using a controller.
Fixed some incorrect stat displays in stat page / inventory quick reference.
Fixed Fizzbang's mortars ignoring resistances (Act 5 boss 1).
Fixed bug where you could bind one controller to multiple players when starting local co-op.
Fixed crash if having too many auras in local co-op.
Fixed issue where Moving Prayer would not remove the applied stats after wearing off.
Fixed stairs down portals being rendered underneath ground effects from spells, making them hard to see.
Fixed early companion stat Mastery nodes not working for some classes.
Fixed issue with quest/achievement updates with NPC "Semmy" in Act 5.
Fixed quest overwrite issues when using characters with different progression in local co-op.
Fixed Lesser Rune of Blood Explosion stacking on itself.
Fixed being able to open Challenge Portals anywhere, leading to some weird problems and in some cases, crashes.
Fixed issue where co-op players' saves would in some cases be considered the "most recent" save and be set as the "continue as ..." for solo quick resume.
Fixed issue with some Highlands anomalies when using water or lava tiles in the mix.
Fixed crash on hitting (A) on empty equipment slot when in the transmutation alter with a controller.
Fixed incorrect interface updates when in Gemma's interface with a controller.
Fixed some inconsistent stat rounding on the interface.
Fixed multiple missing ds errors/crashes.
Fixed some issues with buying 10x and 100x items with keyboard & mouse.
Fixed issue where spell scroll/codex might use the wrong rank spell.
Possible fix for Wings of Sziirk dropping you inside walls sometimes.

notes.title: Update 1.00.6: Chinese support, tweaks, and fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I am back in health and back at work, fixing issues and tweaking stuff!

This update improves support for custom translations by adding an in-game menu to change language from, and it also adds the first official translation: Simplified Chinese! In the future I plan on adding support for more community translations by adding additional fonts, such as Korean. I may be adding more official translations down the line as well.

This update also fixes a few crashes and tweaks a few things. Thanks for all the reports, comments, and suggestions! I am now shifting focus entirely to 1.1, which will bring a lot of new QoL features, buff/tweak a lot of sets and items, add a save backup system, endgame improvements, and also fix a large amount of bugs - among other things!

Thanks everyone!

1.00.6:
Enchants & Powers:

All enchants & powers that required a silly amount of Greater Augments to reach cap no longer do so.

Combat:

Tuned down some enemy AoE effects that were likely to one-shot you.
Added a few frames of invulnerability after a "save from death" effect has triggered so you don't die regardless before being able to react due to rapid/queued hits.

Translations:

Added the first official translation: Simplified Chinese!
Your custom translations will now be discovered by the game and selectable from the in-game menu, so you don't have to manually edit the config file to change language anymore.
Incorrectly set up languages will default to English.
Help index can now be translated and have been moved to locale/help.

Fixes:

Fixed memory leak related to belt items.
Fixed a few crashes related to corrupt characters.
Fixed a some loading problems.
Fixed being able to drop items on the current stash tab and the stash eating them.
Fixed The Last Word (Berserker fist) not working.

notes.title: Update 1.00.5: QoL & Fixes + info
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for your continued support and reports!

This is another bugfix update that takes care of a large amount of issues.
I've also added some slight QoL features that were requested in the past few days.

I have been asked about a roadmap with future plans so I will be making one sometime soon, where I will list my plans for some time ahead. However here's a short summary of the next few steps:
I will soon shift my focus entirely to 1.1 which will largely be a huge QoL update with skill tweaks, interface tweaks, improved anomaly layouts, wider language support, and much more!
And after that, I shift my focus to something bigger. 

More on this later!


Thanks everyone, I hope you enjoy!

Here's the full notes:
1.00.5:
Loot:

Swapping items between inventory and Stash now lets the Favorite mark take precedence (if either the source or target stack is favorited, the new stack will be favorited).
You can no longer transmute or drop favorited items, preventing accidents.

Interface:

Improved some skill descriptions and fixed some grammar errors.
Minimap scale now goes down to 50% (was minimum 100%).
Most UI elements have had their max scale setting increased from 300% to 400% to accommodate huge screens & resolutions.
Clicking a Grave in the Graveyard now autoscales the popup a bit to allow for larger numbers (and longer translations) to fit.
The unfinished stash icon feature I added by accident earlier (oops) now lets you loop the icons by right clicking continuously.

Monsters:

Plague Spinner spiders now spawn in Forgotten Chambers in Act 1 (they only appeared in Anomalies before).
Castle Guards now spawn in The Courtyard and Clairebourg Halls in Act 3 (they only spawned in challenge areas before).
Caecus Dolo (The high Priest) now laughs a lot less frequently during combat.
Lowered the damage of Fizzbang's skills (first boss Act 5).
Lowered the volume of all bats and rats high-pitched squealing.

Skills:

Poison Arrow is now called Poison Shot to further emphasize that it is not an "Archery" skills (Druid tree has no Archery skills).
Improved pathing and behavior of Seeking Arrow (Warden) so it should no longer get stuck.

World:

Improved spawn locations of some NPC's so they dont end up in walls.
Going into The Sacrificial Grounds and rescuing the Sorcerers without accepting the quest now auto-starts the quest upon rescuing them.
Anomaly hellfort layouts with a lot of dead ends have been made more rare (1.1 will bring improved layouts!).

Fixes:

Fixed Talisman of Spines not counting Utility skills.
Fixed Amulet of Despair not working with lower value slowing effects (such as 30% slows from Tangled Growth (Warden), etc).
Fixed the damage reduction from the Bloodbinder Set (Warlock) not working.
Fixed players doing more powerful attack grunts when using Utility skills.
Fixed Thornbough not always spawning in Thornbough Garden.
Fixed issue where on-hit effects such as "Smite" etc would trigger the diminishing return feature for the direct hit that trigered the Smite, causing it to deal less damage.
Fixed exploit with the Blood Explosion rune.
Fixed crash from Pylon beam spells.
Fixed Satellite enchants not being affected by dynamic crit rate chances, from buffs, passives, and powers like Jeopardy, etc.
Fixed Tesla (Templar) and other chain-lightning effects not working.
Fixed Widespread Inferno (Warlock) not spreading stacks (it does not add stacks by triggering, but now correctly spreads existing stacks to nearby foes with lower stacks).
Fixed being able to move bosses with Lightning Wyrms (Berserker/Codex).
Fixed game unpausing or sometimes even crashing when a controller is disconnected while the game is paused.
Fixed the Codex not recording deaths.
Fixed Mechanical foes not being affected by dots, debuffs, etc.
Fixed Diana Jones in act 4 saying the wrong lines after finding the key.
Fixed some area portals which play sounds as you find them playing these sounds on repeat.
Fixed some mobility/teleport skills such as Dragon Warp and Snow Blast not going the correct distance when using a gamepad.
Fixed scrolling in dialogue scrolling at different speed with different text scaling settings.
Fixed player dismissing dialogue with negative voice lines even if you had read it through.
Fixed getting stuck after talking to some act 5 npc's.
Fixed old GMS logo on startup.
Fixed crashes due to bad data in graveyard.
Fixed some overlay problems in the New Hero screen.
Fixed a missing text debuff from Act 5.
Fixed incorrect mouse shortcuts listed for selling x10 items.
Fixed crash when exiting Room of Abundance.
Possible fix for people who were unable to import their exported builds.
Another possible fix for the silly missing doors in Hellfort anomaly layouts.

notes.title: Update 1.00.4: Fixes & Tweaks
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!


Thanks for the reports!
This is another small update to take care of most of the recent issues, as well as adding some tweaks to overtuned monsters and such.

Please let me know if any issue was not fixed for you, or if you run in to any other issues!

Also, in case you missed it, the official soundtrack is now available, here.


Thanks everyone!


1.00.4:
Combat & Monsters:

Adjusted the health of Captain Moore and granted him a new skill.
Adjusted the damage scaling of some bosses during story mode (before level 100).
Slightly lowered the damage of Oculus and Gazer enemies.
Removed the improved Bone Spear skills from the Oculus (now uses regular bone spears).
Mobility skills should now trigger "on move" powers and passives.
Changed the blood color of some act 5 demons.

Fixes:

Fixed some quest overwrite issues when playing in co-op with characters that are not synced in the story.
Fixed Moore just standing there like a fool and not using his throw and charge ability.
Fixed issue where Moore and misc Champions using the default "strike" attack would have a super short damage radius and mostly miss.
Fixed Embershield (Berserker) not playing sound effects when hitting foes.
Fixed Holy Blade (Templar) not passing through foes.
Fixed satellite enchants targeting untargetable enemies.
Fixed rare crash from certain twister/whirlwind effects.
Fixed issue where the Frostwyrm 4-piece set bonus wouldn't scale properly with other sources of damage reduction (and not reset itself correctly).
Fixed taunting companions with high cdr using nothing but taunts.
Fixed issue where if attempting to load a killed hardcore character that had been restored intentionally or accidentally, the game would crash.
Fixed some incorrect button shortcuts being displayed while in vendors.
Fixed crash from the Gazer boss in Anomalies.
Fixed Bone Thorns (warlock mastery perk) not working with all Bone skills.
Fixed achievement "Powers Beyond" triggering too early.
Fixed Codex holding a goblin enemy that does not spawn, preventing the Monster Hunter achievement.
Fixed non-living companions and enemies leaving blood on the ground.
Possible fix for the door in Hidden Cellar not unlocking after completing the event.
Possible fix for missing door in Anomaly layouts that are using the Hellfort with Temple tiles.
Possible fix for crash on startup in fullscreen on some Linux distros.
Possible fix for a low framerate problem that could previously be fixed by tabbing in and out.
Added many missing lines to localization.

notes.title: Update 1.00.3: Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!


Thanks for your reports!

This update fixes even more problems than before, and I'm not gonna keep jinxing things by saying we are almost done fixing again :)

Please let me know if you run into any more issues!

1.00.3:
Interface:

Barrier and Damage Reduction skills now correctly state that they lower/prevent direct damage, instead of "all damage" - indirect damage such as dots is not affected by DR and are considered being on the inside of barriers!
Using the Master's Set places a crown over companions, however if nametags are disabled this crown is now also hidden.
Improved minimap of Boinepits areas (and Anomaly layouts with these tiles).
Added description of Gibbing to help index.

Monsters:

Ooglers won't shoot firewalls at you from off-screen ranges anymore.
Ooglers deal less damage with their firewalls.
Firewalls now count as ground effects and can be mitigated with the "reduced damage from ground effects" stat.
Tweaked Act 5 boss stats somewhat.
Mutated Patiens now spawn in Lower Levels and The Dungeon (Act 3).

Fixes:

Fixed being able to use portal scrolls during boss fights in act 5.
Fixed being able to gamble Jon's Book of Souls.
Fixed issue where if you previously got stuck in The Molten Sea in a certain location you could still get s tuck in the quest chain, and not be let in into the Fortress.
Fixed frost satellites shooting through walls and with endless range.
Fixed being able to sell all items in a stack and then buyback the entire stack for the price of 1 item.
Fixed The Thundering Cave and Cavern of Insanity being super loud when you approach.
Fixed Achievement "Jones Would Be Proud" not triggering.
Fixed Ni saying "MISSING TEXT!".
Fixed the Codex incorrectly listing several monster spawns on The Test Chamber area.
Fixed some incorrect quest descriptions.
Fixed the stash eating favorited items on page 2 and up when hitting auto sort.
Fixed issue where optional room portals (stairs) could overlap in Fortress of Hatred - Depths.
Fixed using Auras, Heritages, etc that applied generic stat buffs on use overwriting other sources of said buffs (shrines, passives, etc).
Fixed Quickdraw (Warden) not working with Multishot or Scattershot.
Fixed issue where if you had The Golden Touch mastery perk, you would not be able to spring the trap for the optional quest "Hidden and Trapped".
Fixed not being able to exit the codex with (B) on gamepads.
Fixed invisible walls in the skull island Anomaly layout with the bone pits style.
Fixed weird lava tiles on wall tiles in Hellscape.
Possible fix for some anomalies having too few monsters.

notes.title: Update 1.00.2: Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks again for the reports! This update should take care of all the larger issues reported since the last update, as well as a few other tweaks. As always, please let me know if you encounter any problems!

I am planning another update during the week where I will specifically target Linux issues, and one in which I will target some localization problems to help those of you working on translations!

Thanks!

1.00.2:
Interface:

Korem's title is now "Guide & Skill Resets" because it as very unclear what he does!
Clarified the description of Lesser Rune of Thundering Avatars (it's their cooldown, not yours!)

Crafting:

Crafted items now always roll with perfect base stats.

Fixes:

Fixed a ton of problems with incorrect and missing texts, bad spacing, etc.
Fixed the Crater layout for Anomalies not spawning exits or sometimes layering exits.
Fixed Searing Burrow not spawning any monsters.
Fixed Seeking Arrow (Warden) not casting if you didn't have a target.
Fixed not being able to start Demon Hunter Semmy's quest if you didn't have the quest to find him first.
Fixed multiple issues with quest updates upon entering some late zones in act 5.
Fixed crashes from dialogue that could happen if you accidentally scrolled at the exact same frame as you interacted with the NPC.
Fixed not receiving the final quest from Death.
Fixed being able to enter the Fortress of Hatred before finishing the required quest.
Fixed Waypoint not spawning in The Molten Sea.
Fixed Molten Sea portals disappearing if the zone was reset or re-visited in a new session after obtaining the Guardians Quest.
Possible fix for lockups when entering A Dark Chamber and Storage Area.

notes.title: 1.0 is live! Full release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9566989/2ae0ed379557f4f5df915c3b1e9670eb005e3f62.png

Hey everyone!

After 5 long years in Early Access, we are launching fully!
Amazing. Thank you everyone who has supported me & the game over the years, and thank you for being part of the journey!

As with all of my larger updates you can expect some issues slipping through the cracks, so I will be hovering the forums for the next few hours, ready to help & note any issues. Hopefully it should go smoothly though! Expect fixes in the next week for anything that might pop up!

And after that, well, I got some cool stuff planned. More on this later...
Let's go!


1.00.0:
Major Additions:

Added Act 5, complete with 29 new areas, 23 quests (8 optional), 12 new unique items from 12 unique monster spawns, 7 new enemy types with a total of 27 variations, 6 new troves to find, and 5 new big bosses to fight!
Added 24 new Legendary+ items.
Added 24 new endgame Runes.
Updated 26 items with new powers, improved powers, or power tweaks.
Updated & improved 14 sets.
Updated & improved 9 Runes.
Added new Anomaly bosses, layouts, and rare modifiers.
Added 20 new Achievements.
Added many suggestions and QoL improvements.
Added over 120 new sound effects to monsters, bosses, interface, etc.
Improved performance.
Fixed a bazillion issues, and probably introduced some new :-)

Items, Sets, & Runes:

Items:

General:

Changes:

Normalized all Legendary weapon attack speeds to 100% - with a few exceptions where attack speed is a focal point.
Normalized all unique+ power roll ranges.
Life Guard (TL Helm): Now also reduces damage taken from indirect sources. GA buffed to 50%, up from 40%.
Hydrascale Boots (TL Boots): The HPR increment based on missing health is now always active.
Weyrick's Crown (TL Helm): Has been nerfed to 3/4% A/GA (down from 5/6%).
Crown of Solitude (Helm): Now has an extra strong Crown Slaying power (rune-able) and drops at level 20 (up from 1).
Gaia's Binding (Ring): Renamed Terra's Binding and now has a combined +all res and +all elements enchant (rune-able).

New:

Boots of Hazard (Boots): Tick Health on Hit when standing in hostile ground effects, and take much less damage from ground effects.
Aspect of the Ethereal (TL Ring): All indirect damage enchants apply a debuff dealing the same amount of damage per second as Ethereal, stacking infinitely and lasting 7 seconds.
Crown of Innate Probability (TL Helm): All skills with any chance effects, proc rates, etc, have a x% increased chance to trigger.
Talisman of Spines (TL Amulet): For each assigned skill that is Utility, Ultimate, Companion, Aura, Heritage, or Ritual, thorns is increased by x%.
Primordial Rose (TL ring): Every 3 seconds, resistance to a random element is increased by X% for 3 seconds.
Stormchasers (TL Boots): Damage increased by x% for each twister, gust, whirlwind and similar type of effect within 5 meters.
Gemstone Tiara (Helm): Any gems inserted into this helm also provide the bonuses from being in a weapon or jewelry slot.

New Unique Foe Drops (Act 5):

Skin of Terror (Armor): Has 3x Star sockets, and comes socketed with gems.
Fang of Alucard (Accessory): HoH is xxx% more effective.
Ancient Bone (Accessory, Warlock): Bone skills deal increased damage.
Eye of Hazioxth (Amulet): Reveals nearby invisible foes.
Shizbuk's Tail (Accessory): Provokes and pulls random nearby foes when attacking.
Ring of Hunger (Ring): Mana Regeneration is increased for each nearby foe. Bosses count as 15 foes.
Skull of Harlon (Helm): Vastly increased Projectile skill range & damage.
Molten Skin Boots (Boots): Vastly increased Ground Effect Skill duration and damage.
Sight Beyond (Accessory): +Reach, +Pickup Radius, +Light Radius
Stone of Tephra (Accessory): Thrown skills and Stone skills (Berserker) deal greatly increased damage.
Skull of Grimm (Relic): Use: Cast Bone Curse V.
Wing of Sziirk (Relic): Use: Teleport up to 10 meters forwards and deal 300% fire damage to all foes teleported through.


Templar:

Changes:

Ring of Blades (Ring): Now also commands the Blades to attack the Templar's target.
Phantoma (TL Sword): Is now Sword-only, and now greater augments up to 100% (was 45%).
Crown of Justice: Now Greater Augments up to 30% (was 25%).

New:

Contra (TL Shield): Each time a foe is stricken by a Shield skill they suffer x% increased damage from all Shield skills, stacking infinitely.
Venerata (TL Sword): Magic skills attack x% faster and have 25% chance to doublecast.
Prayer Beads (TL Accessory): While still, Auras have x% increased range. While moving, Auras have x% increased effect & damage. Effect has a 3 second overlap.
Faith (Amulet): Using an Aura causes a nova for x% damage in the element of the Aura. Damage affected by Aura Effect, and may trigger on-hit effects.
Contender (Helm): While within 5 meters of any Crowned foe, Damage Reduction, Block Chance, and Damage is increased by x%.


Berserker:

Changes:

Moe's Fury (Fist): Fists of Fury shoots projectiles instead of punching, and deals x% increased damage. Skill counts as Thrown skill.
Face Breakers (TL Fist): Max stacks reduced to 4 (down from 8). Damage per stack reduced to 40% (down from 50%). Yeah, it was OP.
Icebergs (Fists): Now increases Shattering Cold damage and gives it an AOE effect.
Floes (Fists): Is now called Floe Fist.
Improved icons of Spirit set fist & claw, and updated the name of the fist (to Spirit Fist).

New:

Haymaker (TL Fist): Brawl skills have a 50% chance to be cast at up to 2 additional random targets for X% increased damage. (no mobility skills)
The Last Word (TL Fist): Increases damage and range for Shout skills, dealing more damage the closer foes are.
Ancient Claw of The Firstborn (TL Offhand): Dragon skills attack X% faster, have X% less cooldown, and last X% longer.
Mantle of the Dragonkin (TL Accessory): For each nearby foe, maximum rage is increased by X. Rage-based passives are Y% stronger. Bosses count as 15 foes.
Drakefoot (Boots): Increased damage of Dragon Stomp, Earthshatter, and Icicles.
Rimeheart (Ring): Increases the range and damage of Rime.
Frozen Anger (Accessory): +x Minimum Rage.
Paingrinder (Accessory): Increased thorns and bleed damage.


Warden:

Changes:

Gaia (TL Bow): Now Greater Augments up to 20% (was 15%).
Harp (TL Bow): No longer depends on multishot, and has its own augmentable value for number of arrows shot in a cone. Now also goes up to 10. (Was 9)
Serenity: Now augments up to 80/100 (A/GA) - was 75/85.
Loaded Bolts (Offhand): Radius set to 3 meters, now augments bonus damage for Double Draw.
Wrap's of the Lone Ranger (TL Acessory): Now Greater Augments up to 15% (up from 10%).
Packleader's Vest (Armor): Now also increase the damage of all wolves.
Armor of The Elven Ranger (Armor): Now augments up to 20%, and greater augments up to 30% (was 15/20%).
Wolf Tooth Necklace (Amulet): Now causes a bleed for 100% damage, up from 50%.

New:

Fungimancer's Loop (Ring): Fungi skills deal xx% increased damage. Spores spawned from Fungi skills are twice as strong.
Sniper's Eye (Helm): Foes hit by Archery skill become weakened, taking increased damage from all skills.


Warlock:

Changes:

The Death Speaker (TL Staff): All curses that do not have a damage over time effect now deal an additional X% of the total remaining damage of all curse damage over time effects on that foe. Hand of Death, Blood Curse, and Flesh Rot now stack infinitely.
Book of Meteora (TL Offhand): Now drops an actual Meteor spell at rank 5, but at x% increased efficiency, rather than an Ethereal meteor at 300% damage.
Pestilence (Ring): Efficiency of Infection procs from companions reduced to 25%. 
Death's Bond (Ring): Curse of Woe, Curse of Terror, and Curse of Reckoning are automatically cast once per second at the Warlocks location. Requires the Warlock to equip one of the skills. The skills deal x% increased damage.
Book of Duplus (Offhand): Now Greater Augments up to 75% (up from 30%).
Staff of Screaming Skulls (Staff): Now makes Screaming Skull bounce between foes rather than spiral the Warlock. Bounces up to x times.
Jon's Book of Souls (Offhand): Is now a TL item.

New:

Grimm (TL Staff): Bane skills deal increased damage based on Reach.
Simulacra (TL Staff): 25% chance on casting a Sorcery skill to spawn a magical clone of the Warlock, casting the same skill with x% increased damage.



Sets:

General:

All For One (TL set): Now interacts properly with other effects (except Lusombras, as intended).
One For All (TL set): Now increases all Elements by triple the highest resistance stat.

Templar:

Avatar of Ayeela: 2) +Hallowed deals 100% increased damage.
Caine's Battlegear: Old 3) bonus moved to 2) (does not replace old 2)). 3) Now makes Holy Fire deal 100% increased damage with each consecutive hit.

Berserker:

Bloodsoaked Garb: 3) bonus now doubles the effectiveness of bleeds when using non-stone skills.
Dragonfire Garb: 2) Destr.Man. now deals 200% increased damage instead of triple proc. 3) Bonus damage buff now stacks 20 times at 10% rather than 40 times at 5%.
Spiritual garb: 3) Soul Burn increased to 100% (up from 25%)
Cataclysmic Battlegear: 3) Stalagmites deal 200% increased damage rather than triple proc. and the damage per hit boost has been adjusted (15% up from 5%).
Skysoul: Buffed debuff DoT to 150% up from 70%.
Northern Rage: Frostbound's damage is now affected by Rage Release's damage %, and related Masteries.

Warden:

High Ranger's Gear: 2) now also increases the damage of Razor Tips by 100%.
Windcaller's Regalia: The merging effect of the Whirlwinds have been moved to the 2) bonus, and the 3) bonus now makes Windwalker last until death, and makes it cast rank 5 Gale every 5 seconds.
In addition, whirlwinds no longer spawn in pairs, but deal double damage instead, and have smarter merging to prevent some frame drops.
Stormcaller Set: The Static now considers the total burn damage as part of the triggering hit when adding a charge.
Wispmother Set: 2) now makes Wisps target whatever the player applies Wisp Spark to.


Runes:

General:

Changes:

Lesser Rune of Focused Lightning: Is now Lesser Rune of Chained Focus & now affects all skills with the "Chained" tag, rather than "chain lightning skill effects" (this will make more sense going forwards).

New:

Lesser Rune of The Bombardier: Bombardment skills deal x% increased damage for each second of duration, however their base duration is halved. Bombardment skills without a duration gain 3 seconds worth of bonus damage.
Lesser Rune of Relentless Assault: Assault skills no longer cost any mana, restore 3% mana on use, and have their cooldowns reduced by x%.
Lesser Rune of The Sentry: Sentry skills deal x% increased damage and last x% longer, however their radius is halved.
Lesser Rune of Splitting Throws: Thrown skills that are not thrown in an arc may now split on cast, creation X copies of itself going in random directions.
Lesser Rune of Bouncing Throws: Thrown skills that arc and hit the ground may now bounce up to X times, traveling an additional 2 meters and dealing damage on each bounce.
Lesser Rune of Polished Gems: Each socketed gem adds x% damage to the gem's element (color), regardless of the shape of the gem.
Lesser Rune of Brutal Attacks: Damage is increased by x% for each percentage attack speed below 150%. Any percentage below 100% attack speed grants twice this bonus.
Lesser Rune of Greatness: +1 to Greater Rune cap.


Templar:

Changes:

Lesser Rune of Rolling Thunder: Now Greater Augments up to 75% (up from 35%).

New:

Lesser Rune of Holy Chains: Cinderblast and Holy Bolt are now Chained skills and may jump up to 4 times. Deals increased damage.
Lesser Rune of Provocation: Foes affected by Provoke take x% increased damage.
Lesser Rune of Holy Expulsion: Expulsion deals X% increased damage when triggered from Holy Nova hits.
Lesser Rune of Thundering Avatars: Soul Avatar has X% increased attack speed and cooldown reduction, and summon an additional Avatar.


Berserker:

New:

Lesser Rune of Winter Rage: Glacial Roll, Arctic Leap, and Frigid Roar deal x% increased damage and generate twice as much rage on hit.
Lesser Rune of Rage Peak: Glacier consumes all rage on cast, dealing x% increased damage per 5 points of rage.
Lesser Rune of The Blue Bolt: Dive also casts a free Dragon Storm when used. Dragon Storm deals x% increased damage.
Lesser Rune of Soulstorm: Dragon Souls triggered from Dragon Storm deal x% increased damage
Lesser Rune of Ancestral Rage: All rage-based passives & heritage effects now always give a minimum of x% of the effect, regardless of current rage level.
Lesser Rune of Targeted Destruction: Destructive Manoeuvres now attempts to target a random enemy within range, and will apply a stacking burn effect to all foes struck, dealing x% of the damage dealt, per second, for 5 seconds.


Warden:

Changes:

Lesser Rune of Poison Trees: Now has a % modifier to the effect of Barbed Spores.
Lesser Rune of Bramble Burst: Now also affects Vine Shot, Bramble Storm, and Vine Blast.
Lesser Rune of Trap Throw: Now also changes Lay Traps into a Thrown skill, letting it synergize with new effects.
Lesser Rune of Split Thunder: Now makes one of the splits auto-target a random foe within range.
Lesser Rune of Multishot: Now also affect Scattershot and Volley.
Lesser Rune of Great Hail: Now Greater Augment up to 100%.

New:

Lesser Rune of Acrobatic Barrage: Cast Volley on using Escape or Tumble, however Volley is now highly inaccurate. +Volley damage.
Lesser Rune of Norla's Gale: Gale now follows the Warden and lasts 7 seconds. Gusts and Tornadoes cast also spawn on each Gale whirlwind. +Gust and Tornado damage.
Lesser Rune of Swelling Pods: Pods no longer deal damage in a radius when bursting, and instead add X stacks to itself. Pods also deal double base damage.
Lesser Rune of Mega Wisp: Mega Wisp is more powerful, and Empowered Wisp stacks 10 more times.
Lesser Rune of Sparking Static: Static deals increased total damage (yes, including the set bonus burns), based on number of active Sparkies.
Lesser Rune of The Wolfcaster: Air Freeze and Ice Shard now summon charging wolves instead, with their damage based on Wolfpack and Alpha Wolf respectively.


Warlock:

Changes:

Lesser Rune of Reaping: Life Reap deals x% increased damage to foes affected by Curse of Woe, Curse of Terror, and Curse of Reckoning (bonus stacks).

New:

Lesser Rune of Total Armageddon: Armageddon has +x% proc rate.
Lesser Rune of Instant Combustion: Detonation now triggers Combustion on all foes affected by Flaming Hells. Combustion deals x% increased damage.
Lesser Rune of Exploding Blood: Poison Nova now explodes all Living Blood and Clot for x% increased damage.
Lesser Rune of Putrefying Poisons: All Corruptor skills also apply Blood Curse and Flesh Rot at max rank for x% increased damage.




Skills:

General:

Expanded on the skill tag system and granted every skill 1-2 tags.
Some skills have been granted already existing tags, such as "Nova", whereas most have been given brand new ones.
Added new skill tags: Chained, Thrown, Ground Effect, Projectile, Sentry, Assault, Bombardment, Fungi (Warden only).
Updated some skill and mastery descriptions to be more clear.
Base melee skills now use a radial hitbox affected by reach and lists their radius on the tooltips.
Rapid or double hitting base skills (Fists of Fury, Lightning Jab, etc) has a slightly lower base range of 1.1 meter radius. Shield base skills also have this radius, as they have a higher base damage.

Berserker:

Hungering Call and Dragon Warp should now both break objects properly.
Ice Slam has had its damage lowered slightly but in return has the largest radius of all base melee skills (2 meters vs 1.5 standard).
Dragmageddon is now limited to 5 instances.
Rime now has a visual aura effect.
Rage Release now triggers after a few frames, stacking up damage from very rapid triggers to improve both performance and visual clarity.
Built Up Rage (Mastery Perk): Increased to 5%, up from 1%.

Templar:

Reduced some of the sound effects from Shield Spiral.
Blaze now auto-cleanups when you get a larger trail going, to prevent some frame-rate issues.
The fire pit left by Exploding Shield now correctly triggers related effects such as Contra, but is limited to 8 pits. However the duration has been reduced by 3 seconds.
Supercharged (Mastery): Is now called Charged Auras.

Warden:

Wolves: No longer howl, and will instead growl, because this is less annoying on repeat.
Wolves: Now have attack/hurt/death/spot sounds.
Vine Shot: Now deals direct damage on all ticks, and now pulls foes harder the further away they are, rapidly grouping them together.
Storm Shrooms: Now benefit from the Shroomtender set stacking damage debuff.
Tornado: Now moves faster (double speed) but lasts shorter (-1 second).
Winter Storm: Instance limit increased to 7. (Was 4)
Increased instance cap of Bramble Storm, Nimbus, Lightning Arrow, and Blizzard by 1.
Changed arrow VFX for the skills used with Harp.

Warlock:

Masochism: Lowered regeneration bonus to 3/4/5% per stack, down from 6/8/10%.
Undeath: Lowered Health bonus to 6/9/12%, down from 10/15/20%.
Relish In Their Pain: Lowered regeneration bonus to 14/22/30%, down from 30/50/70%.
Soul Feast: Increased the recovery to 5%, up from 2,3,4%, but added a 15/20/25% chance to trigger.
Detonation: Reduced screenshake.
Bursting Boils: Is now only triggered from Poison skills.
Fire Storm, Bone Storm, and Affliction: Has been capped to 5 instances.
Bone Storm: Now follows the Warlock.
Frozen Soul (Mastery): Is now called Lich Heart.


Combat, Companions, and Mobs:

Bleed, poison dot, etc enchants now deal a damage tick on each application.
All damage over time effects now tick once per second, rather than some ticking twice and some ticking once. Note: the base DPS remains the same!
Lowered health of King Slimes.
Removed target circles from killstreak spells.
Removed target circles from some companion spells.
Improved coloring of many monster variations.
Camera now zooms on player on death.
Game Over screen made more clear.
Added Golem gibs.
Gibs and breakable object fragments that fall into pits/void no longer stops mid-air, and now fades and falls down. If landing in water, they will cause a small splash.
Added spawning animations for 5 more monsters (some new, some existing).
Reduced collision box on some Warden companions so they get around corners easier.
Removed Sticky Targeting.

Interface:

Re-ordered the item codex to place all non-set items in the same order based on class, slot, and quality.
The item Codex now displays additional info on items (such as Ring of Marvellous Gems "Rolls random permanent sockets").
Sound Volume slider is now called Sound Effects Volume to be more clear.
Removed some old tips from the loadscreens that no longer apply.
Added some new loadscreen tips.
Shifted mouse tooltips on buffs a few pixels to the right.
Improved minimap icon display so that icons are revealed in a slightly larger radius than tiles are.
Improved item tooltips so skills referenced are highlighted with their element color.
Drastically improved item card visual clarity when scaling down large cards to fit the screen.
Moved some stats on the inventory quick stat pages to make them fit better.
Improved handling of damage numbers with auto-cleanup for massive amounts of numbers and reduced frequency of overlapping numbers by shifting them vertically and having indirect damage move with an angle.
Damage number from special effects such as the Desecrator set skull bomb effect are now larger and always on top. The same applies to stacking DoT effects -  after 10 stacks they'll be prioritized.
Damage numbers are now depth sorted with the highest value being on top.
Damage number auto-cleanup will now remove lower numbers before bigger ones.
You can now ctrl-click items in the inventory and stash to quickly drop them.
You can now alt-click items in the inventory and stash to favorite them. Favorited items cannot be sold or auto-sorted until un-favorited again.
You can now buyback a full stack (shift + lmb), or buy 100x from stackable stuff in sotres (also shift + lmb).
Improved the buff tooltips, fixing some alignment and spacing issues.
The text saying "all enemies have been granted the X affix" when entering unstable dimensions and rare anomalies now says "all crowned foes" instead, to clarify.
Fixed Codex cards not being named correctly when printed (f10).

Added 120 new sound effects to enemies and bosses.

Performance:

Improved texture memory handling to try and keep the memory allocation lower.
Improved framerate on death.
Improved performance for many instant on-hit triggers by making them auto-cleanup their visual effects sooner if there are very many being triggered.

Improved performance for for Berserker and Warlock by delaying some instant UI updates a few frames.
Improved internal handling of Gems & stat calculations.
Improved performance of rapid interface updates.
Improved temp data handling, removing some redundant data or stuff that can be easily recreated from saving, reducing disk access somewhat.

notes.title: Update 0.98.0 - Endgame difficulty rebalance, tweaks, fixes, new stats
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update should take care of the issues with indirect damage suddenly being extremely lethal, as it was balanced when a bug that was fixed in the previous update was active. I also added two new stats and enchants to specifically let you deal with indirect damage if you find your preferred form of defenses lacking in that area. While I was doing that I figured I'd take a poke at the endless tier scaling, as it rapidly got a bit out of hand, and - as always - I got a bit carried away and made a larger update than intended. I've also fixed a couple issues that popped up, gave Warden some tweaks, and poked at a few other things here and there. 

Anyway, hope you enjoy this update!

Now I'm off to dig myself deep into Act 5 work :-)


Here's the full notes:
0.98.0:
Difficulty & Mechanics:

Rebalanced all indirect damage and DoT damage from enemies, and gave it an upper cap - indirect damage can no longer deal more than 5% of your health in damage per strike/tick. Best way to combat indirect damage is by your preferred method of sustain (hoh, hpr, healing skill/codex, etc) rather than beefing up your health pool. (And using the new stats, of course!)
Tweaked enemy damage bonus curve through endgame difficulties - once you get high enough (endless T42 and forwards) the curve flattens and becomes liniear, so you can shift focus to doing more damage instead of avoiding pesky one-shots.
Similarly, enemy health bonus flattens on T100, and starts to slowly pick up again as you progress further.
Increased bonus experience per endless tier reached.
Enemy "on hit" affixes are now calculated as the final step in damage calculation, meaning after shields and such has been considered.
Suffering Thorns damage now has an internal cooldown of 20 frames so you don't nuke yourself on Thorn packs.
Thorns still punch through shields (as intended).
Trap damage now scales with difficulty (oops).

Skills:

All:

Lightfooted (Perk) now also affects companions.

Warden:

Companion passives buffed:

Moon Howl (Wolves) damage boost increased to 11/18/25%, up from 9/12/15%
Empowerment (Pixies) damage boost increased to 10/15/20%, up from 6/8/10%
Antivenom (Spiders) resistance boost increased to 20/30/40%, up from 15/20/25%
Thorny (Treants) thorn bonus increased to 30/50/70%, up from 9/12/15%
Oak Wisdom (Treants) mana bonus increased to 10/20/30%, up from 12/15/18%



Stats & Enchants:

Added two new defensive stats: Ground Effect Resistance, and Indirect Damage Resistance.
Added enchants for the new stats: Ground Effect Resistance can be found on Boots and Accessories. Indirect Damage Resistance can be found on Helmets and Amulets. Both are considered Minor enchants.

Interface:

Improved stat panel on the interface by dividing stats into more clear groups.
Help index updated with new stats.

Fixes:

Fixed characters playing powerful skill shouts/grunts on default attacks (when not having any skill assigned in leftmost slot).
