notes.title: Status Report: Engine Port & Next Update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's been a while since I last made an announcement or released an update, so I figured I'd get everyone updated on what's going on!

As you may know, I am using GameMaker: Studio to develop Chronicon, and have been using the 1.4 version for a long time now. However, this version has now been discontinued, meaning it will get no more support or updates in the future. So I was left with no option other than to port the game to the new 2.1 version of GameMaker: Studio.

This version offers better performance and a lot of new tools to make my life easier, as well as many fixes for some annoying issues (yay!). But it also does a lot of things differently, meaning some of the stuff I was relying on no longer exists or has been changed fundamentally. So what might seem like a simple software upgrade turned into having to rewrite a ton of stuff, and in some place write entire new things!

This has been taking longer than expected, but I am now at a place where most things are functional and it's mostly just refinement, tweaking, and testing left. If you want to help out with any of the testing, feel free to join the Community Discord Server and check out the pinned messages for how to opt-in to the special "Tinka Builds", where you get raw, buggy, versions of what I am currently working on. I'd love to hear how it runs for you, especially if you've had problems in the past with low framerates. If you've tested it before, there's a new version available as of this announcement.

There's also some new things coming with this update such as better (and skippable!) boss intros, a new dialogue system for NPC's, a few new Transmutation recipes aimed at endgame content, and some other neat stuff. Should be something for everyone!

The update will be released as soon as possible, but it's too soon to estimate exactly when. So stay tuned!

Thanks!


Note: The Tinka Builds are currently Windows-only.

notes.title: Update 0.81.0 - Transmuting, Radial Looting, New Equipment, CD/MC tweaks, and much more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

As I was preparing to port the game to a new engine I realized I should probably leave you guys with some fresh content before I disappear for a while working on that, so here's a content update!

This update introduces a lot of new stuff.. could almost have made it a Major Content Update! Some highlights of this update includes the new Transmutation crafting NPC, Theo! He'll help you craft and combine new items from some known recipes.. and some from hidden, unlisted recipes that only the most clever and perceptive heroes will find. He can also help you modify your items in new ways, such as unlocking previously augmented Enchants, or empowering Legendary items to copy the base stats from True legendary items. All for the min/max :-) 

There's also some neat QoL features like "hotswapping" selected active skills, allowing you to pick one of their alternatives at a whim without resetting your point allocations. There's also a new Radial Loot feature, where you will loot everything matching your item filters (set up in the Gameplay options) within your Pickup Radius. Pretty nifty!

This update will also address some recent chance and concerns with my ongoing iterations of the cooldown and resource management. There's always room for improvement, but we have found a pretty good base for things now, I believe!

The game now also officially supports community translations to Simplified Chinese, and all skill descriptions and names has been added to the pool of external text, for anyone to take a look at and/or translate. Future updates will bring item text and the remaining in-game text to a readable format as well! However the game does not ship with any translations at this point.

As always I'd like to thank everyone for continuing to support the development by reporting bugs, posting feedback, and sharing ideas!

I'll be around for the next few days to keep an eye on things and see if there's any bugs that need fixing, but after that I'll start the porting which, depending on how difficult ti becomes, may result in a bit of an update drought until it's done. But after that you can expect some big things on the horizon!

Stay tuned!

Update 0.81.0:
New Mechanics:

Transmutation:

A new NPC has moved into The Chronicon, speak to him to learn about Transmutation!
Many new items (equipment, consumables, relics) has been added that can only be obtained through Transmutation
Unlocks account-wide after beating Act 3 on any character (yes, retroactively too)

Damage Stagger:

This is a new stat available to all classes that staggers a portion of all damage taken over 3 seconds
The Berserker has 15% Damage Stagger as base
Damage Stagger is calculated after resistances, Damage Reduction, etc, but before Shields
Damage Stagger stat stacking is multiplicatively calculated, like Damage Reduction, Evasion, etc

Global Damage Diminishing Returns:

Slightly lowers damage of "shotgunning" effects that happen instantly on the same frame, by lowering the damage of each individual hit that frame
Only affects direct damage, so skill procs etc remain unchanged
It's mostly intended as a way to lower the amount of extreme damage spikes on the player, which along with Damage Stagger makes for a more smooth experience without "cheap shots" - especially in Hardcore mode

Radial Looting:

Pressing Q (default, can be changed) now loots all items fitting your filters within your Pickup Radius
Can be set to only loot non-equipment

Dungeon Shady Dealer:

A Shady Dealer may spawn in any area of the game at random, from level 30 and up.. he's got some interesting wares for sale, which will vary somewhat each time you find him

Skill Hotswapping:

You can now hotswap skills from the same skill slot in the skill trees, meaning if you for example picked "Cleave" instead of "Shield Slam", you can swap between them without resetting all points spent
The hotswap can be done by right-clicking the skill in the skill tree (as you would when binding it) and clicking "Swap" instead of a hotkey
Note: Hotswapping will clear buffs and companions just like the Elixir of the Mind does, so you can't hotswap between two different buffs (or ultimates) and use both - it is simply a tool to make rapid changes to your build with little effort

Empowered Shrines:

Shrines may spawn as Empowered, granting two random effects instead of one!
All Shrine spawns are now also randomized between sessions and area resets


Anomalies:

Removed all narrow cave layouts
Added many new combinations of layouts and locations

Classes:

Berserker:

Slightly lowered rage generation from taking damage
Doubled minimum rage generation from dealing damage, and slightly lowered maximum
Increased the rate of which Rage fades, and the amount faded per tick
Rage fade is now paused during cutscenes
Now has +15% Damage Stagger as base stat

Warlock:

Soul duration now refreshes when collecting a Soul while at max Souls
Soul fade is now paused during cutscenes


Enchants:

Added new enchant:

Damage Stagger:

Adds to the new Damage Stagger stat, is considered a Major enchant, and can only be rolled on Helmets, Armors, and all offhands *except* Shields


Changed existing Enchants:

Maximum Rage:
 
Max augment is now at +22 Max Rage, down from +30

Mana On Hit:

Slightly increased augment caps and roll ranges
Can now be rolled on all off-hand items and helmets

Health on Hit:

Evasion:

Damage Reduction:

Can now be rolled on Armor

Effect Duration:
Reach:
Mana Cost Reduction:

Can now be rolled on all Weapon types

Pickup Radius:

No longer rolls on *everything*
Can now only be rolled on Armor, Accessory, Weapon, and Boots
Max Augment lowered to 40%, down from 45%



Gems:

Kyanite Cube:

While in weapon, now increases mana on hit by 10/15/30%, up from 5/10/20%


Gameplay:

Zoning now grants slightly less bonus time on killstreaks
Troves now more clearly indicate that they're special by showing a message when opened
Players are now completely purified and healed when killing a boss
HP/MP Regeneration ticks no long happen during cutscens
Hitting enemies mid-spawning animation where they're invulnerable now refreshes the killstreak timer by a very tiny amount
Added some more telegraphing to various skills
Improved the visuals of telegraphing effects 
Added a "radius loot" button based on your pickup radius, default is Q and will loot everything in range according to your loot filters
Does not have a default button for gamepad as we're running out of buttons! But you can bind it in the options if you want. Gamepads will receive some love soon!
Quest-related NPC's are now always revealed on your map
The "Annihilation" and "Godlike" killstreak meteors now deal damage based monster health and difficulty/anomaly level, rather than player stats
Made many improvements to Click To Move movement based on player feedback:

Can click more freely in void/unreachable areas and character will still attempt to move
Can bind skill slot hotkeys more freely without issues (ie all keys on LMB will now work with click to move)
Improved responsiveness and slightly tweaked pathfinding


Interface & Options:

Added an option to the gameplay menu to pause the game if it loses focus (if you click outside or minimize etc)

Items:

Mightcap

Added other new items:

Changed items/powers:

Localization:

All skills text (names, description etc) is now externally stored and available for translations
Skill keywords etc is now also stored externally
Added support for Simplified Chinese for community translations (change font_type="latin" to font_type="chinese" in the text data file to load up the correct font)
Items and remaining text is coming soon

Monsters:

Affixes:

Bleeder now damages much less
Added new "Frost Blitz" affix to the affix pool for Champions

Boss:

All:

Boss Health now scales slightly higher with base difficulty, and increasingly so with Anomaly levels
Bosses now clear any active spells when dying, so players don't die after the boss has died

Shrines:

Shrine locations are now randomized between sessions/resets
Added new "Empowered Shrines", which may randomly spawn. These shrines will always grant two random effects!

A new experimental change has been added to select skills, where they have had their cooldowns drastically reduced and their mana costs equally drastically increased

Mana cost of skills have been overall changed to not grow linearly with your base mana anymore, instead, most skills will require much less on lower levels before they reach their intended per-level cost, so you get a smoother progression and learning curve
Berserker:

Frost Winds:

notes.title: Major Content Update #6! Hardcore Mode, Cooldown + Ultimate skill Overhaul, Companion updates, new stats, items, and much more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Major Content Update #6 is here, and with it, the Hardcore mode!
And not to mention Linux support!

In this update I have changed a lot. Needless to say you will likely have to tweak your builds a bit, but rest assured that you should be able to get even further now. The changes will be mostly noticeable if you make a new character, as almost all skill cooldowns have been lowered by 30-50%!

That being said, however, many stats have been made multiplicative, including Cooldown Reduction. 

Check out the excellent (and 0.80.0 compatible) builds on the Builds Forum - Rahlence and jon_12345 have both been very busy creating new builds and helping me test everything to make sure it all works well! A big thanks to you guys!

And thanks to everyone for your reports, this update should take care of all recent, and some of the more long term issues as well. This being a new major update, I'm moving to a fresh thread with bug reports, found here. Let me know if you encounter any issues and I'll get right on it!

As always with these big updates, there will be a 20% off sale, starting tomorrow (April 27th)!


Below is a summary of the changes, since the whole update notes are too big to fit! You can read the full notes here.

Enjoy!


0.80.0:
TL;DR:

Linux support
Hardcore mode
Ultimate skills overhauled
Skill cooldowns and damage differences improved
Quest log improvements
Quest tracker
50+ new sound effects and improved sound & music quality
Companion improvements
CDR, MCR and effect duration are now multiplicative stats
New stats:
 
Gem Strength and Satellite Damage

Base class stats adjusted
Monster damage & AI aggression adjusted
New & updated enchants + Legendary effects
New Legendary and True Legendary items
Difficulty rebalanced
Drop rates rebalanced
Fonts updated
Skill + item cards updated to look better and fit smaller res / higher scaling better
Improved performance
More controllers supported natively
Fixes

notes.title: Update 0.75.0 - Warlock sets & skills update, performance improvements, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!


The last class update is now complete!
As expected, this one covers the Warlock and all his sets, passive skills, and also features some changes to both utility, companion, and ritual skills.

I also did a lot of performance work, so you should experience much less slowdowns and frame drops during larger and intense fights!

Another noteworthy change is that Shield/absorption effects are now visible on your healthbar, and will also absorb indirect damage such as burns, poison, bleeds - etc. As such, you will also find that the Warlock makes good use of shields in this update.

As always I've fixed all recent reported issues, and even managed to find and fix some of the more elusive, persistent bugs that have stuck around for ages. Hopefully I didn't introduce that many new bugs this time around :-)


Next up is taking a final pass at all the classes, focusing on the ultimate and companion skills primarily, but also taking a look at how some stats and enchants are used and distributed. You can expect ultimates to become a bit more streamlined and all around more useful for a wide array of builds, and companion builds to become stronger overall. I have some exciting and secret new features in the works as well, which I think you'll like! All of this will arrive approximately in mid-late April.

Meanwhile we are also working on the final act, but as you probably already know, it'll take a long time and there are many things to be added in first! I'll be sure to update you when any significant progress has been made.

And lastly I would like to thank everyone for their contributions to the Chronicon community and your continued support of the game!

I hope you'll enjoy this update!

2) Infection now stacks infinitely.

notes.title: Update 0.74.0 - New Warden sets, skills, fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Here comes the Warden update!
All her sets and passives have been revamped, her masteries adjusted, and even some active skills have had some significant updates. If you play a Warden then this update is definitely for you, and if you don't, well, there's never been a better time to roll one!

I've also added a few tweaks to other things, and fixed all reported issues.

The low frame rates tied to energy saving / clock speed problems are still being investigated - thank you for being patient!

If you're on Linux, you'll also be happy to know that there's a functioning, although a little unpolished, Linux build available! It needs a bit more work before I am ready to announce full support. It's mainly targeting Ubuntu, but other distros may also work. Just logging on Steam from a Linux machine should get you the Linux version as expected.

Thanks for the continued reports and feedback, and a special thanks to the guys who helped me test the sets and Linux builds!

Hopefully I didn't break too many things and I'll see you with the Warlock update in a few weeks :-)


Update 0.74.0:
Anomalies:
Killing an Anomaly boss now restores the player and their companions to full health, and removes any harmful effects
Anomaly Bosses now remove all their lingering spell effects such as poison clouds and traps when killed

Gameplay:
Knockbacks into walls will no longer make AI/players float a bit against the walls, and will instead cancel the knockback effect immediately, and play a sound effect to emphasize
AI leaping into walls (with Leaper affix) will do the same

Items:
Warden:
Thunder Point (Arrow):
Now increases the number of jumps of Static, rather than the proc rate of Lightning Rod


Sets:
Warden:
High Ranger's Gear:
High Ranger's Gift and High Ranger's Deadeye now always roll bonus bleed damage
Reworked, now does the following:
2) Overdraw has 100% chance to trigger, and Double Draw now triggers all on-hit effects.
3) Razor Tips bleed stack infinitely, and Double Draw has 100% chance to trigger.
4) The Warden gains 40% Damage Reduction, and Double Draw now always matches the damage of the skill triggering it.


Windcaller's Regalia:
Reworked, now does the following:
2) All Physical skills spawn small Whirlwinds on the foe. The Whirlwinds deal equal damage to the skill that triggered them, per second, and lasts 3 seconds. 2 meter damage radius.
3) Whenever two Whirlwinds collide they merge into a larger Whirlwind, adding their their damage up and refreshing the duration to 5 seconds.
4) The Warden gains 40% Damage Reduction, and Whirlwinds always spawn in pairs.


Shroom Tender Armor:
Reworked, now does the following:
2) Spores always trigger on cast, and all mushrooms spawned from Spores grow in pairs.
3) Mushrooms now grow from each foe hit by the Spores. Mushrooms now also weaken nearby foes when popping, causing them to take 10% increased damage from all mushrooms. This effect stacks infinitely.
4) The Warden gains 40% Damage Reduction. In addition, mushrooms now cause chain reactions when popping, setting off any nearby shroom regardless of growth their stage.

Everspring Raiment:
All pieces renamed to "Everspring's" instead of "Spring's" for consistency
Everspring's Thorn now always roll Effect Duration
Reworked, now does the following:
2) Pods stack infinitely.
3) Pods have an increased 20% chance to burst, and when bursting they spawn small twisters, dealing the same amount of damage per second, for 3 seconds.
4) The Warden gains 40% Damage Reduction, and Bloom is twice as likely to trigger.


Stormcaller's Regalia:
Stormcaller's Aim now always roll attack speed
Reworked, now does the following:
2) Lightning Rod and Static now both have 100% chance to trigger.
3) Lightning Rod now stacks on each hit, multiplying the damage dealt on each hit by the number of total hits on the target.
4) The Warden gains 40% Damage Reduction. Foes afftected by Lightning Rod also take 20% more damage from Lightning skills.


Armor of the Wispmother:
Reworked, now does the following:
2) Lightning skills apply Wisp Spark to foes, making them take the same amount of damage as the skill dealt when hit by Wisps. Wisp Spark lasts 5 seconds.
3) Spawns an additional 3 Wisps.
4) Wisp Spark now stacks infinitely, and the Warden gains 40% Damage Reduction.


Torrential Raiment:
Torrential Arrow now always roll attack speed
Reworked, now does the following:
2) Hail always trigger
3) Pummel stacks infinitely, and Pelted strikes twice as fast
4) The Warden gains 40% Damage Reduction, and Pelted lasts forever


Snowstorm Armor:
Reworked, now does the following:
2) Foes affected by Winter's Chill take 15% more damage from Snow Blast
3) The bonus damage effect of Winter's Chill now stacks infinitely
4) The Warden gains 40% damage reduction, and Hail now triggers both Winter's Chill and Snow Blast





Skills:
Templar:
Vengeance (Physical):
Enchanted Arms:
Now has a 100% chance per block to trigger Static Overload



Warden:
Wind Ranger (Physical):
Rapid Shot:
No longer costs mana
Now deals 50/55/60/65/70% damage, down from 110/120/130/140/150%

Gust:
No longer costs mana
Now deals 100/110/120/130/140% damage, down from 125/130/135/140/145%
Now bounces off walls

Scatter Shot:
Now deals 115/130/145/160/175% damge, up from 110/120/130/140/150%

Razor Wind:
Now has a 4 second cooldown, down from 5

Volley:
Now instead fires a volley of arrows forwards in rapid succession, rather than all at once in a nova
Damage reduced to 100/105/110/115/120% damage per arrow, down from 210/220/230/240/250%
Amount of arrows reduced to 7/9/11/13/15, down from 12/14/16/18/20s
The Warden may move after firing the first arrow
Has diminishing returns vs. a single target

Tornado:
Now bounces off walls

Treant Strider:
Now rolls the boulder towards the player's cursor/target, if they have any, otherwise against their own

Treant Guard:
Now leaps to the target location and taunts
Taunt now has a 5 meter radius (unaffected by reach at this point)

Tailwind:
Skill removed

Double Draw:
Now deals damage based on the triggering skill, and may crit

Expertise:
Now lowers the mana cost of Multi Shot/Scatter Shot/Razor Wind by 40/60/80%, up from 15/30/35%

Splinters:
Now has a 50/60/70% chance to trigger, up from 14/22/30%
Now deals damage based on the triggering skill
No longer crits

Razor Tips:
Now deals damage based on Splinters' damage

Razor Cuts (M):
Now increases Razor Tips damage by 3% per rank, down from 5%

Fragmentation (M):
Now increases Splinter proc rate by 3% per rank, up from 1%
Now has 10 ranks, down from 20


Druid (Poison):
Spore Wind:
No longer costs mana
Now deals 100/110/120/130/140% damage, down from 125/130/135/140/145%

Poison Arrow:
No longer costs mana
Now deals 100/110/120/130/140% damage, down from 130/140/150/160/170%

Spore Rain:
Now deals damage based off a 110/120/130/140/150% damage Spore

Natural Toxins:
Skill removed

Barkskin:
Now adds Damage Reduction, instead of Physical resistance

Thornskin:
Adds 200 more Thorns at max level & max rank

Wild Growth:
Now available at level 5, down from 10

Spores:
Damage is now based on triggering skill

Growth:
Damage is now based on Spores, deals much higher damage

Toxicology:
Damage is now based on Spores, deals much higher damage

Pods:
Damage is now based on impact damage of triggering skill
Now available at level 10, down from 20

Bloom:
Now restores 3/4/5% of Maximum Health, rather than 2/4/6% of damage dealt
Proc rate changed to 3/4/5%, down from 9/12/15%

Storm Shrooms:
Now deals damage bosed on the mushrooms damage multiplied by the percentage of the Lightning Rod skill

Forest Ward:
Now applies Spores for 200% Poison damage

Blossom (M):
Now caps at 10 ranks (75% increased healing of Bloom), down from 20 ranks (150% increased healing of Bloom)

Nature's Reclamation (M):
Now increases Pods damage by 3% per rank, down from 5%


Storm Caller (Lightning):
Shock Orb:
No longer costs mana
Now deals 100/110/120/130/140% damage, down from 125/130/135/140/145%

Charged Arrow:
No longer costs mana

Agility:
Now increases Evasion by 5/10/15%, up from 4/8/12%

Sprint:
Now increases Movement Speed by 18/24/30%, up from 15/20/25%

Force of Nature:
Skill removed

Static:
Now deals damage based on the damage taken by the foe
Increased proc rate

Lightning Rod:
Now deals damage based on the damage taken by the foe
Increased proc rate

Charged Lightning (M):
Now increases Lightning Rod damage by 3% per rank, down from 5%


Winter Herald (Frost):
Frost Arrow:
No longer costs mana

Frost Bomb:
No longer costs mana

Winter's Kiss:
Skill removed

Hail:
Now deals damage based on the triggering skills' impact damage
Now has a 25/35/45% chance to trigger, up from 4/8/12%

Pelted:
Now uses the damage of the strongest applied Hail

Snow Blast:
Damage is now based on triggering skills' impact damage

Snow Storm (M):
Now increases Snow Blast damage by 3% per rank, down from 5%

Frozen Barrage (M):
Now increases Hail damage by 3% per rank, instead of proc rate by 1% per rank
Now has 100 ranks, up from 20
Is now available at 20 points spent, up from 10

Winter's Embrace (M):
Is now available at 10 points spent, down from 10
(Switched places with Frozen Barrage (M))




Misc:
Updated localization file for menus

Fixes:
Fixed Hallowed (Templar) being able to "double dip" with crits (critting when spawned from a crit)
Fixed Expulsion (Templar) also being able to double dip crits
Fixed Wargod Set (Templar) 3p bonus being able to double dip crits
Fixed Soul Replica/Avatar (Templar) being able to be re-casted for an infinite amount of companions when wearing the Thundering Army set
Fixed Splinters (Warden) animation not showing consistenly between skills
Fixed Trapflip (Warden) not dealing damage unless placed directly on top of a foe
Fixed Glacial Roll (Berserker) not working with click to move control scheme
Fixed Crown/Beast/Fae etc damage enchants not working with passives, triggered effects, and some DoTs
Fixed loading issue related to the personal stash
Fixed issue that in very rare cases, almost entirely when playing multiplayer, could wipe the stash or inventory of a player during loading
Fixed issue where companion re-summons would be inconsistent
Fixed being able to click through the credits roll and click on menu buttons
Fixed skill cards on Companion and Ultimate skills listing "none" as their skill type (should just be blank)

notes.title: Update 0.73.1 - mostly fixes and experimental 4K changes
notes.notes:
Hey guys!


This update is almost entirely a bug fix, taking care of all recent issues, as well as a few older ones. I've included some experimental scaling for those of you who play on 4K, as with some setups the game would run very, very poorly in this resolution. The scaling is on by default, and you have to tick "True 4K" in the Video settings to get the actual full 4K render, or it'll just upscale. However if you had problems with 4K before, don't tick that!

Please let me know how it works, as I don't have a 4K monitor to properly test it myself. :c

I'm also making progress on the Linux build.. I've gotten as far as it starts.. and freezes for seemingly no reason. I'm planning some public tests soon, and will have more info on that later!

Anyway, that's all for now.
Thanks for all reports and support!

Have a good weekend!


Update 0.73.1:
Additions:

Added an option to render in true 4K (default is now off - it used to always be on when having a 4K monitor, but it can lead to problems such as slowdowns, fps drops, and visual errors) 

Fixes:

Fixed inconsistent wording on various sources of % thorns
Fixed Star Fall (Templar) not indicating duration
Fixed Blaze (Templar) not correctly calculating damage
Note:Due to the changes made to Blaze, the Ultimate skill Fiery Blaze no longer works, so it has been temporarily(?) removed
Fixed issue with skill ranges being incorrectly written out because of a rounding issue when the skills had multiple range indications
Fixed quest "Chasing Mystery" not always updating properly
Fixed some quest typos
Added a double check to quest objectives in multiplayer as they sometimes will only progress for one player (let me know if any newly obtained quests still get stuck)
Added a retroactive check that will hopefully unstuck any previously bugged quests that weren't able to complete (also let me know if you have any quests with a 1/1 objective remaining after this update)
Fixed issue causing some doors and locks to remain locked even after an objective was met under certain circumstances
Fixed potential crash and state issue with Eazima
Fixed Ruh-Falkas children being able to push her into awkward locations causing some animation issues
Fixed issue which may on rare occasions clone your satellite enchants

notes.title: Update 0.73.0 - New Templar sets and skill updates, community suggestions, fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

This update is very significant if you play Templar, as all sets and associated skills have been updated, and she's even got a brand new set! I've also put in some general tweaks and additions, as well as a few community suggestions, so there should be something for everyone in this update.

As always, I've also fixed a bunch of issues you guys have reported (thanks!), but lately I've been getting a lot of reports on things that are difficult to verify and find. Because of this, the known issues list is growing pretty large so I'm taking the next week or so to focus entirely on fixing bugs before continuing with the Warden sets & skills.

After the Warden update, only the Warlock remain, and after his rework I'll do a final pass over all classes and make some fine tuning based on your feedback. I'll also be taking a look at the Ultimate skills during this final pass.

Meanwhile, we (me and Jericho, the artist) have also begun work on Act 5, as well as a few other, secret things. As you may know I tend to work on everything at the same time :-). Act 5 will be the final act before 1.0 release, and it will also be the most cool, fun, and quite possibly largest. If you've been a part of the Chronicon community for a while you know the acts take a long time to do, so please be patient as we meticulously work our way forwards!

Anyway, let me know if you have any issues with the update, be it technical or design, and I'll get right on that.

Have a good weekend!

2) Burning Conviction can now stack infinitely.

Reworked, now does the following:

2) Expulsion now has a 100% chance to trigger
3) Each trigger of Expulsion adds Radiance to the Templar, adding 2% attack speed and movement speed, stacking up to 25 times. Effect lasts 5 seconds.
4) Radiance adds 40% Damage Reduction.


Avatar of Ayeela:

Updated item icons
Reworked, now does the following:

2) All Holy skills trigger Hallowed on hit, using the damage dealt as a base for the skill.
3) Hallowed also apply Judgement to foes struck by it, dealing the damage of Hallowed over 3 seconds. Stacks infinitely.
4) Receiving any form of healing blesses the Templar with 40% Damage Reduction for 5 seconds.

Updated coloring of some Templar skills and skill tabs to more clearly indicate what element they are

Frostborn (Frost):

Now drops the icicles at a set distance, unaffected by reach, so more reach = more icicles

Vengeance (Physical):

Shield Slam and Cleave no longer cost mana
Master of Arms removed

Now deals 100/110/120/130/140% damage, down from 140/150/160/170/180%

Now deals 105/120/135/150/165% damage, down from 160/175/190/205/220%

Now deals 220/240/260/280/300% damage, up from 170/190/210/230/250%

Shield Spiral:

Now deals 205/235/265/295/325% damage, up from 165/195/225/255/285%

Shield Boomerang:

Now deals 185/215/245/275/305% damage, up from 145/165/185/205/225%

Now requires level 5, down from 20

Damage increased to 25/50/75% per second, from 15/20/25%

Enchanted Armor:

Now requires level 15, up from 10

Block:

Now requires level 10, up from 5

Now requires level 20, up from 15

Bladed Shield:

Now requires level 25, down from 30

Valkyrie:

Now requires level 30, up from 25

Sharpened Blade:

Renamed to Bloodied Blade
Now causes Sword Dance/Sword Hurl/Dancing Blades to deal an additional 10/15/20% damage to foes affected by Sharp Steel bleeds

Enchanted Arms:

Changed entirely, now triggers Static Overload when blocking, using 500% of the damage blocked as base for the Static Overload damage 
Now available at 35 points instead of 40
Now requires Citadel


Wrath (Lightning):

Sparkstrike and Lightning Blade no longer cost mana
Jolt removed
Lightning Blade:

Now deals 100/110/120/130/140% damage, down from 140/150/160/170/180%

Sparkstrike:

Now deals 111/122/133/144/155% damage, down from 151/162/173/184/195%

Avenger:

Now lists the damage dealt as various sources can change it

Static Overload:

Can no longer crit because of damage "double dipping" with the triggering skill's crits

Soul Replication:

Now affected by the Templar's resistances, crit, and Companion Health and Companion damage stats, like regular companions

Soul Avatar:

Now affected by the Templar's resistances, crit, and Companion Health and Companion damage stats, like regular companions

Magnetic Orbs:

Mechanic update: Now places a stackable buff on the Templar, increasing damage each application rather than increasing amount of orbs
Max 3 stacks currently
Will now persist through loading screens
Now always summon 4 orbs

Magnetic Field:

Mechanic update: Now places a stackable buff on the Templar, increasing damage each application rather than increasing amount of orbs
Max 3 stacks currently
Will now persist through loading screens
Now always summon 5 orbs


Conviction (Fire):

Sear and Singe no longer cost mana
Warforged removed
Sear:

Now deals 100/110/120/130/140% damage, down from 140/150/160/170/180%

Singe:

Now deals 105/120/135/150/165% damage, down from 160/175/190/205/220%

Burning Conviction:

Now deals 30/40/50% of impact damage per second, up from 20/30/40%

Condemnation:

Now deals damage based on the remaning damage of Burning Conviction
Can no longer crit because of "double dipping" with Burning Conviction crits

Pain of The Condemned (M):

Now increases Condemnation damage by 3% per rank, down from 5%

Intense Conviction (M):

Now increases Burning Conviction damage by 3% per rank, down from 5%

Blaze:

Damage is now based on the triggering skill's average damage
No longer triggers on-hit effects when dealing damage
Can be refreshed by weaker skills, maintaining damage


Redemption (Holy):

Smite and Holy Bolt no longer cost mana
Zeal removed
Smite:

Now deals 100/110/120/130/140% damage, down from 140/150/160/170/180%

Expulsion:

Is now chance on hit, and requires the triggering skill to be a Holy skill
Now deals damage based on the damage of the triggering skill
Proc rate reduced to 20/30/40%, down from 40/70/100%
Damage adjusted to 20/35/50% of impact damage, from 80/120/160% flat damage

Plea:

Now grants slightly less Health on Hit (scales with level)
Now grants slightly less Mana on Hit (scales with level)

Ascension:

Health on Hit and Mana on Hit lowered to 100, down from 300

Avatar of Life:

Health on Hit and Mana on Hit lowered to 75, down from 150

Ayeela's Precense (M):

Health on Hit lowered to 2 per rank, down from 4

Sanctified:

Now grants slightly less Health on Hit (scales with level)

Favor:

Now grants slightly less Mana on Hit (scales with level)

Hallowed:

The damage is now based on the amount of healing received

Sacred (M):

Now increases the damage of Hallowed by 3% per rank, down from 5%

Empowered Expulsion (M):

Now increases the damage of Expulsion by 3% per rank, down from 5%




Stats:

Adjusted most sources of Health on Hit and Mana on Hit
HoH/MoH now scales with skill base average damage% of the skill used, i.e. slower and harder hitting skills grant bonus HoH/MoH compared to rapid hitting skills, regardless of how much the skill actually hit for

Monsters:

Affixes:

Nova:

Now shows a target circle before triggering
Now has a shorter radius on the Fire Nova


Wizzas:

Nerfed their damage output by quite a bit


Fixes:

Fixed issue that prevented both Sharp Steel (Templar) and Bladed Shield (Templar) from benefiting from bonus Bleed Damage
Fixed error on Repulse(Templar) skill description
Fixed incorrect skill reference on Shock (Templar Mastery)
Fixed Ice Dash (Warden) giving 1% of intended Movement Speed boost
Fixed issue preventing Expulsion (Templar) from using the correct proc rates
Fixed Heat Wave (Warlock) being off-center
Fixed Shield Throw (Templar) using one bounce too little when calculating final damage on single targets
Fixed Destructive Manoeuvers (Berserker) being able to crit
Fixed issue with Berserker Frost Heritage skills causing them to incorrectly calculate valeus when Minimum Rage was increased via passive skills
Fixed issues with Glacial Roll (Berserker)
Fixed the Fountain Puzzle in the courtyard disappearing if using a portal 
Fixed various Crystal Puzzles throughout the game disappearing if using portals
Fixed Secret triggers/buttons/things sometimes disappearing if using portals when there were puzzles nearby
Fixed crash when using Hallucinative Gas (Warden) near certain breakable items or the test Dummies
Fixed visual effects from Ultimate skills, such as wings, remaining visible when character is not visible
Fixed Wisps (Warden) only dealing 1 damage when not having any Empowerment buffs active
Fixed Dancing Blades (Templar) sounding like Hyenas (yup)
Fixed issue where burrowing monsters such as Sandworms would get stuck with the Explosive affix

notes.title: Update 0.71.0 - Holiday Event, Berserker set & skill updates, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Happy holidays everyone!

This will be the last update of 2017. It features a neat little holiday event, available for characters level 10 and up, from which you can get some time limited equipment and other things. Mostly just for fun but it'll probably help your characters who aren't max level yet!

In addition to that this update also rolls out the first iteration of the updated sets and passive abilities. First out is the Berserker, with 8 fresh sets and a bunch of skill changes. The set updates are also retroactive so if you already have them you don't have to grind up the new versions.

Now, I know some of you have voiced concerns that because of these updated and very good sets, the game will shift and become heavily set oriented for end-game. This is partially true, as it will lean in favor of sets until near launch where I will be introducing more end-game features to allow deeper builds and itemization. So if sets don't float your boat, hang in there!

In addition to that I've made a few adjustments to progression and difficulty scaling of Anomalies, a few QoL improvements here and there, and a ton of bug fixes.

2017 has been a great year for both me and the Chronicon community, and I remain very thankful and proud of what we've accomplished together. 
Thank you for the hundreds, if not thousands, of bug reports, thoughts, suggestions and feedback you've sent me over the year. The next year I am aiming for 1.0 release and I hope you'll all be along for the ride!

That's all for this time, and unless I broke something (for which I will entirely blame Tinka), we'll see each other again in the next year. Exciting times ahead!



0.71.0:
Christmas Event:

Added a special christmas-themed event (requires level 10 to trigger)
Bosses and elite monsters will drop random gifts
Anomalies may roll special themed decorations
The Chronicon has been decorated for the occasion
Tinka has been up to something again...
Some new themed equipment has been added for each class, which may only be found in the new event location
New enemy sub types can also be found in this event location
Event lasts to December 31st

Difficulty & Progression:

Made some slight adjustments to difficulty scaling post Legendary
Adjusted Mastery Exp requirements into brackets of 500 levels - each 500 is a slight jump on top of normal reqs

Enchants:

Maximum Rage:

Now grants at the most 30, down from 50


Items & Loot:

True Legendary items now have a 20% higher base value than Legendary items
Pain Lid is now Templar only
Flickerfang (claw) is now an accessory
Foul Schematics (spellbook) is now an accessory
Gems:

Citrine Star:

Now grants 5/8/15 to Maximum Rage, down from 5/10/20

Kyanite Star:

Now grants 3/5/8 to Minimum Rage, down from 3/7/12


Sets:

Berserker:

Bloodsoaked Garb:

Reworked, now does the following:

2) Bloodbath also increases Bleed Damage by 15% per stack.
3) Foes who die under the effect of Internal Hemorrhage erupts in an explosion of blood, dealing 250% of the total remaining damage of the effect to all foes within 3 meters.
4) Internal Hemorrhage now stacks infinitely, and Bloodbath reduces damage taken by 40% while active.


Cataclysm Armor:

Reworked (and renamed to Cataclysmic Battlegear), now does the following:

2) Quake has 100% chance to trigger.
3) Stalagmites strike 3 times, and always trigger on Quake.
4) Stonefist, Earthshatter, and Boulder all deal 30% more damage and grants the Berserker Earth Ward for 10 seconds. Earth Ward lowers damage taken by 40%.


Spiritual Garb:

Reworked, now does the following:

2) Spirit Link now connects to up to 6 foes to the host, and all foes affected take 20% more damage from all sources
3) Soul Link now deals damage in a 2 meter radius.
4) Spirit Link now also links with the Berserker, transferring 40% of the damage he receives to the host


Breath of the Sky:

Reworked (and renamed to Skysoul Fragments), now does the following:

2) Dragon Soul adds a debuff dealing an additional 70% damage per second for 5 seconds, stacking infinitely
3) Dragon Spirit has 100% chance to trigger and Dragon's Grace now deal damage in a 2 meter radius
4) Dragon Soul has 100% chance to trigger and Dragon Spirit adds 40% Damage Reduction


Volcanic Garb:

Reworked, now does the following:

2) Molten Veins has a 2 meter wider range and is now also triggered on attack.
3) Thorns damage is increased by 10% for each point of Rage, and Lava Blood has 100% chance to trigger
4) Lava Blood now stacks infinitely and every 3 points of Rage adds 1% Damage Reduction to the Berserker


Dragonfire Garb:

Reworked, now does the following:

2) Explosive Manoeuvres have a 100% chance to trigger.
3) Explosive Manoeuvres and Destructive Manoeuvres adds Rampage to the Berserker when triggered. Rampage stacks 40 times and increases the damage of Explosive Manoeuvres by 5% per stack for 5 seconds.
4) Destructive Manoeuvres strike 3 times when triggered, and Rampage adds 40% damage reduction for the duration.


Gust of the Frost Wyrm:

Reworked, now does the following:

2) Frost Winds have 100% chance to trigger.
3) Frost Winds now always trigger 3 at a time, and the maximum amount of active Frost Winds is increased by 5.
4) Frostbite stacks infinitely. Frost Winds adds 40% Damage Reduction to the Berserker when triggered. Effect lasts 5 seconds.


Northern Rage:

Reworked, now does the following:

2) +300% Rage Generation.
3) Frost skills apply Frostbound to foes, causing them to take the same amount of damage as the skill dealt when hit by the next Rage Release. Effect lasts for 5 seconds.
4) Frostbound now stacks damage infinitely, and Rage Release now grants the Berserker 40% Damage Reduction for 5 seconds when triggered.





Interface:

Items that require a higher level now have a more orange background instead of red, for quick identifying
Changed draw order of interface elements so that item boxes/names are drawn above name tags etc.
Adjusted some text & number locations on the HUD
Added updated interface detailing to all classes (UI box edges)

Skills:

All:

Damage over time effects now generally tick at a slower rate (but for more damage per tick) for performance reasons (it also removes a bunch of extra damage numbers)
Damage over time effects and other non-triggering efects now produce more balanced numbers for an exact average output
Slightly lowered the volume of many damage impact sounds

Berserker:

General:

Skills that deal "X% of skill Y's damage" no longer crit, preventing "double dips"
Removed mana cost of all base skills and lowered their damage to 100/110/120/130/140%, down from 140/150/160/170/180%
Removed the mana cost reduction passives for the base skill from each tree
Adjusted Rage gain calculations from hits as it scaled incorrectly at high levels

Heritage skills no longer adds "X% to stat Y at Maximum Rage and half at Minimum Rage"
Instead, adds "X% of current Rage to Stat Y"

Guardian (Physical):

Inner Strength: 

Clarified tooltip

Internal Hemorrhage: 

Now based on the impact damage of the skill that triggers it. Now available at level 15, down from 20
Deals 30/50/70% of the triggering skills' impact damage per second, for 3 seconds

Cripple:

Now slows by 35/50/65%, up from 25/35/45%

Quake: 

Now based on the impact damage of the skill that triggers it
Has a 30% (up from 10%) chance to instantly deal 40/50/60% of the triggering skills' impact damage in a 2.5 (up from 1.5) meter radius

Stalagmites: 

Now based on the damage of Quake

Bruised: 

Now available at level 20, up from 15

Tremors (Mastery):

Now grants 3% bonus damage per rank, down from 5%

Leap:

Now deals 170/190/210/230/250% damage, down from 200/220/240/260/280%

Earth & Sky:

Now bases the damage of the triggered Dragon Soul off Quake


Sky Lord (Lightning):

New Skills:

Skydancer:

Adds 2/4/6% Evasion, available at level 5

Soul Link:

Damage taken by the host of Spirit Link is transferred to all links, available at level 20


Dragon Warp:

Now has 2 seconds lower base cooldown
Now deals 240/250/260/270/280% damage, down from 250/270/290/310/330%

Dragon Spirit:

Now has a 9/12/15% chance to trigger on attack (rather than guarantee)
Now increases both MPR and HPR by 50/90/130 (210% with Mastery) while active
Now has 3 ranks, down from 5

Dragon Soul:

Is now chance on hit rather than chance on cast
Requires Dragon Spirit to be active to trigger

Spirit Link:

Now available at level 10, down from 20, and only requires Dragon Spirit to be learned, instead of both Dragon Spirit and Dragon Soul
No longer pulls, but instead slows all foes up to 70%, and grabs one additional foe

Bloodline:

Now available at level 15, up from 10

Amplified:

Now available at level 20, up from 15

Strong Spirit (Mastery):

Now increases the effect of Dragon Spirit by 4% per rank, down from 5%

Fierce Soul (Mastery):

Now increases the damage of Dragon Soul by 3% per rank, down from 5%

Overload:

Now deals 150/170/190/210/230% damage, up from 145/160/175/190/205%

Thunder Punch:

Now deals 225&250/275/300/325% damage, up from 200/220/240/260/280%

Dragon's Might:

Now triggers Explosive Manoeuvres on the target foe of Dragon Soul, basing the damage off Dragon Soul


Dragonkin (Fire):

Flame Roll:

Now moves much faster and with a better sound effect

Dragon Leap:

Now deals 130/140/150/160/170% damage, down from 135/150/165/180/195%

Hot Headed:

Now adds 4/7/10 to Minimum Rage (up from 3/6/9)

Furor:

Now adds 5/10/15 to Maximum Rage (up from 3/6/9)

Fissure:

No longer triggers effects when dealing damage

Molten Veins:

Now deal damage in a radius around the Berserker

Lava Blood:

Now adds a burn effect on foes hurt by Molten Veins, rather than making a puddle of lava

Explosive Manoeuvres:

Now places a single explosion on the foe(s) hit, rather than 1-3 randomly near the Berserker
Damage is now based on impact damage of the triggering skill
Reduced screen shake from explosion

Destructive Manoeuvres:

Damage is now based off Explosive Manoeuvres
Drastically reduced travel range, and now spawns from the explosion of Explosive Manoeuvres, rather than from the Berserker

Total Annihilation (Mastery):

Now affects Explosive Manoeuvres instead of Destructive Manoeuvres 
Now adds 2% damage per rank, down from 5%

Cooling Off:

Now bases damage off Explosive Manoeuvres


Frostborn (Frost):

Hardened:

Now adds up to 5% Damage Reduction instead of resistances

Frostbite:

No longer applies on instance of frost damage per skill
Now bases the dmage on the damage of the skill hit
Now deals 35/50/65% of impact damage per second

Frost Winds:

Now summons max 5 winds

Now deals 35/40/45% of skill damage per second
Now moves with the same speed as the Berserker

Biting Winds:

The Frostbite applied by Frost Winds is now based on the Frost Winds' tick damage

Biting Cold (Mastery):

Now increases the damage of Frostbite by 3% increased damage per rank, down from 5%

Rage Release:

Changed trigger sound effect



Warlock:

Heat Wave:

Hey guys!

Happy holidays everyone!

This will be the last update of 2017. It features a neat little holiday event, available for characters level 10 and up, from which you can get some time limited equipment and other things. Mostly just for fun but it'll probably help your characters who aren't max level yet!

In addition to that this update also rolls out the first iteration of the updated sets and passive abilities. First out is the Berserker, with 8 fresh sets and a bunch of skill changes. The set updates are also retroactive so if you already have them you don't have to grind up the new versions.

Now, I know some of you have voiced concerns that because of these updated and very good sets, the game will shift and become heavily set oriented for end-game. This is partially true, as it will lean in favor of sets until near launch where I will be introducing more end-game features to allow deeper builds and itemization. So if sets don't float your boat, hang in there!

In addition to that I've made a few adjustments to progression and difficulty scaling of Anomalies, a few QoL improvements here and there, and a ton of bug fixes.

2017 has been a great year for both me and the Chronicon community, and I remain very thankful and proud of what we've accomplished together. 
Thank you for the hundreds, if not thousands, of bug reports, thoughts, suggestions and feedback you've sent me over the year. The next year I am aiming for 1.0 release and I hope you'll all be along for the ride!

That's all for this time, and unless I broke something (for which I will entirely blame Tinka), we'll see each other again in the next year. Exciting times ahead!



0.71.0:
Christmas Event:

Added a special christmas-themed event (requires level 10 to trigger)
Bosses and elite monsters will drop random gifts
Anomalies may roll special themed decorations
The Chronicon has been decorated for the occasion
Tinka has been up to something again...
Some new themed equipment has been added for each class, which may only be found in the new event location
New enemy sub types can also be found in this event location
Event lasts to December 31st

Difficulty & Progression:

Made some slight adjustments to difficulty scaling post Legendary
Adjusted Mastery Exp requirements into brackets of 500 levels - each 500 is a slight jump on top of normal reqs

Enchants:

Maximum Rage:

Now grants at the most 30, down from 50


Items & Loot:

Pain Lid is now Templar only
Flickerfang (claw) is now an accessory
Foul Schematics (spellbook) is now an accessory
Gems:

Citrine Star:

Now grants 5/8/15 to Maximum Rage, down from 5/10/20

Kyanite Star:

Now grants 3/5/8 to Minimum Rage, down from 3/7/12


Sets:

Berserker:

Bloodsoaked Garb:

Reworked, now does the following:

2) Bloodbath also increases Bleed Damage by 15% per stack.
3) Foes who die under the effect of Internal Hemorrhage erupts in an explosion of blood, dealing 250% of the total remaining damage of the effect to all foes within 3 meters.
4) Internal Hemorrhage now stacks infinitely, and Bloodbath reduces damage taken by 40% while active.


Cataclysm Armor:

Reworked (and renamed to Cataclysmic Battlegear), now does the following:

2) Quake has 100% chance to trigger.
3) Stalagmites strike 3 times, and always trigger on Quake.
4) Stonefist, Earthshatter, and Boulder all deal 30% more damage and grants the Berserker Earth Ward for 10 seconds. Earth Ward lowers damage taken by 40%.


Spiritual Garb:

Reworked, now does the following:

2) Spirit Link now connects to up to 6 foes to the host, and all foes affected take 20% more damage from all sources
3) Soul Link now deals damage in a 2 meter radius.
4) Spirit Link now also links with the Berserker, transferring 40% of the damage he receives to the host


Breath of the Sky:

Reworked (and renamed to Skysoul Fragments), now does the following:

2) Dragon Soul adds a debuff dealing an additional 70% damage per second for 5 seconds, stacking infinitely

Gust of the Frost Wyrm:

Reworked, now does the following:

2) Frost Winds have 100% chance to trigger.
3) Frost Winds now always trigger 3 at a time, and the maximum amount of active Frost Winds is increased by 5.
4) Frostbite stacks infinitely. Frost Winds adds 40% Damage Reduction to the Berserker when triggered. Effect lasts 5 seconds.

Amplified:

notes.title: Update 0.70.3 available - more fixes and more info about FPS drops (likely solution)
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Another day, another update.
Thanks for the continued reports - hopefully not that many issues left to solve now!

About the FPS drops: with the help of community member Rahlence, I found that the most likely cause for the sudden FPS drops is power saving settings. For some reason, some computers won't recognize the game running as needing processing power and keeps everything in a power saving mode. So check your settings, and make sure it's set to Balanced or Performance, and take a look at your GPU settings as well. More info here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/1291816880493891180/

Now it's just a matter of figuring out *why* some computers won't recognize the game. Oh well.


Anyway, here's the changes of this update:

0.70.3:
AI changes:

Sandworms are now more likely to spawn in the burrowed state (outside of Anomalies), and will burrow more randomly
Added a slight randomization to the "Nova" affix so enemies with it are less likely to burst you down instantly

Tweaks:

Changed drop order of enemies so that they drop materials/gems/crystals before any loot
Adjusted Magic Find scaling for difficulties and Anomalies - higher difficulty now give more bonus MF than before
The Sandworms now burrow for shorter times and distance
Korem will now direct you to talk to Tinka after finishing Act 4

Fixes:

Fixed a possible bad spawn for areas within Deepwood
Fixed entries to some desert areas like the Arena using the wrong image and appearing in the middle of walls
Fixed Korem being reluctant to giving quests for Acts 3 and 4
Fixed Anomalies unlocking after Act 3 (now unlocks after Act 4)
Fixed bad chest spawns in The Orcish Wastes
Fixed crash related to binding the interact key to the keyboard instead of mouse
Fixed crash when hitting the inventory page hotkey (default "I") when being in a vendor page
Fixed crash when using Intimidation after Soul Replication or when there were any active companions
Fixed Trove being marked in the Hidden Cellar even though it doesn't spawn one

notes.title: Bugfixes available! +info on unstable fps
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Thanks for your resilience and patience with bug reporting!
Was this one shaky update or what?

I've released two small updates since the major content patch which should solve most issues reported. If you find any problem please let me know in the bug report thread!

Please note:If you're experiencing the game to be running slowly, choppy or having weird fps drops, please make sure you've checked "Alternative Synchronization" in the Video options! (Also please let me know if that worked or not)

Anyway, here's a summary of what's been changed:

0.70.2:
Options:

Added options (Video Options menu) to enable or disable the heat, bloom, and water shaders

Tweaks:

Player characters won't interupt NPC's talking so frequently
Tweaked some vertex settings which may help with some FPS issues

Fixes:

Fixed crash when talking to Diana Jones if the Mirage quest had bugged
Fixed crash from Lich's Touch accessory
Fixed crash from companion pathfinding errors
Fixed area corruption happening when taking return portals from a sub area and then trying to get back into the main area
Fixed issue where several bosses would temporarily or permanently turn into zombies
Fixed player being able to interact with self and dying
Fixed Chantie and and Tarot saying "MISSING TEXT"
Fixed Diana Jones sometimes having the wrong dialogue
Fixed not being able to change windowed resolution in-game
Fixed the window resetting its position after each load screen



0.70.1:
Misc:

Adjusted Heat shader to not be as intrusive

Fixes:

Fixed crashes caused by skills being triggered by other skills or similar effects, such as the Storm Pendant triggering Nimbus
Fixed crash from several other skills
Fixed some quests failing to update and not being able to be handed in - if you have a quest that got stuck like this, simply do the objective again and it should update properly (in the case of acquiring an item, like the Pixie key for example, just dropping it and picking it up again should do the trick)
Fixed some quests repeating themselves endlessly
Fixed Diana Jones acting weirdly if you don't talk to her when first entering the Lushlands
Fixed crash when generating The Lost City

notes.title: Major Content Update #5 is here!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's finally here - major content update #5!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7kbl0LKlAt8

This is a very big update and not only does it add the whole new Act 4, but it also adds some new content to all three previous acts, as well as a ton of polish to quests, bosses, areas, and more!

In addition to that, you'll be seeing many new enemies and Anomaly bosses and layouts, all with a *slightly* steeper difficulty curve.

Not to mention the all new Spell Scroll and Relic items... this is something you may see much more of in the future!

In addition to that, controllers should now feel even better in combat, the HUD got a slight update, enemies got their resistances re-balanced, most of the mute enemies now got voices, and there's a few new items for you to find.

So what's next?

notes.title: Major Content Update #5 is here!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's finally here - major content update #5!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7kbl0LKlAt8

This is a very big update and not only does it add the whole new Act 4, but it also adds some new content to all three previous acts, as well as a ton of polish to quests, bosses, areas, and more!

In addition to that, you'll be seeing many new enemies and Anomaly bosses and layouts, all with a *slightly* steeper difficulty curve.

I'm working on a Linux port (finally), and I will also be working a lot with existing items and sets, and the mastery trees will see some updates. My focus on the next few updates will be to work towards a greater build versatility and improved progress & itemization.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 0.65.0 Available! New item powers, tons of balance changes, QoL changes, bug fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Thanks for all the feedback and bug reports! This update is heavily based on that, and as such it mostly concerns balance changes to both items and skills, and tons of fixes and quality of life changes. 

There are also 15 new item powers added to Unique and Legendary items! Some of these are completely new, and others are reworked to be more useful and interesting, such as the Jeopardy ring.

With all this in mind, this is a pretty big update, and as per usual that means increased likelyhood that bugs slipped through my testing.

However, I did fix a ton of issues - even some of the more elusive crashes, so I'm hoping for a more stable experience for everyone. Please let me know about any bug or crash that you experience! The more info the easier it is to locate and fix.

Sadly the Windows 10 issues with black/white screens persist, as there has as of yet not been an update to the GameMaker engine. If you have any of these issues, please consult the Troubleshooting thread for temporary workarounds. Hopefully there will be an update soon so we can take care of this for good :)

I will monitor the forums and dedicate the next few days for hotfixing, should it be necessary, so we all can enjoy this solstice weekend!

After any potential issues have been resolved, I will continue work with Act 4. 
It's gonna be a good one!

Anyway - that's all for now. I hope you enjoy the update!

Full patch notes:

0.65.0:
Anomalies:

Shortened the boss spawn animation
Added a Gem & Sockets vendor to Tinka's Domain
Challenge scrolls can now drop in Anomalies
Updated the sprites of several Anomaly bosses
Pyre:

Updated sprite & animations, changed active skills

Venom, Deathchill:

Updated sprite & animations


Areas:

Deepwood + Rosewood + Eastern Wall:

Adjusted generation algorithm to prevent from building outside of minimap bounds, and made the area somewhat smaller

Castle Lower Levels + The Catacombs:

Reduced monster spawn density somewhat, but increased the chance of Elite pack spawns


Bosses:

The High Priest:

Now has a much shorter range and will stay in view

Mundus:

Updated with new sprites and animations


Character & Progression:

Base pickup radius increased to 4 meters, up from 3
Enchanting and Gem vendors are now account wide, so you only have to unlock them once
Killstreak xp gains are now based on how much xp the individual monsters killed are worth, multiplied by a difficulty modifier, scaling logarithmically with the size of the streak (thanks Arkatar for the help!)
Slightly increased base damage growth for melee characters - should mostly be noticable on low to mid levels, and neglible in end-game

Controls:

Using the left stick to aim with controllers no longer disables aiming with the right stick
Using click to move and using the "force move" button (default is spacebar) does no longer attack monsters, and will only force movement

Difficulty:

Adjusted drop rates to be more on par with actual difficulty
Upon reaching Mythical difficulty, enemeis will now start stacking resistances

Gems:

You now need 5x of each gem to upgrade them
Tweaked drop rates further:

Chests now always drop at least one gem
Champions are now guaranteed to drop at least one gem
Elites have a ~25% chance to drop a gem
Slightly lowered gem drop rate off regular monsters
Polished Gems no longer drop, and instead have to be obtained through upgrading

Updated gem stats:

Star Larimar:

Armor: Now adds 3/4/5% Evasion, down from 3/5/7%



Interface:

General:

Added a "Shrines Activated" counter to the statistics page
Companions now have green healthbars, and healthbar visiblity improved in general
If you can't afford a resurrect, the cost will now be displayed in red

Inventory & Vendor:

Quick-sell buttons now sell all equipment up to the rarity clicked, so clicking to sell all Rare will also sell all Ordinary and Enchanted
You can now Ctrl+click (or left trigger + (A)) to gamble 10 items at once
Item card outlines are now in the rarity color
Stats in the inventory pages are now converted to short numbers if they take too much space, ie is over 100k
Added a button to go backwards in the inventory stat pages

Enchanting:

You can now hold Ctrl or Left Trigger to fully Augment an enchant instantly
Holding the mouse cursor over an enchant efter having clicked Re-roll or Augment now shows the cost of doing so

Gemming:

You can now hold Ctrl or Left Trigger to upgrade all gems, instead of one at a time

Minimap:

Icons can now be scaled individually from the options menu


Items:

The base stats of items have a higher chance to roll higher values on higher difficulty & anomaly rank
Slightly increased the max base stat rolls of True Legendary items
Quest rewards and monster specific unique items can now roll sockets upon drop
Jeopardy:

Re-designed effect to be more interesting. Retroactive change - it'll apply to already existing copies of this item

The following items have been updated with new effects, which means you need to find the new versions of these items to get the effects:

All:

Hydra Scales (Unique Accessory)
Skyshard (Legendary Accessory)
Smoldering Gemstone (Legendary Accessory)

Berserker:

Helm o' War (Unique Helm)
Flamebound Armor (Legendary Armor)

Templar:

Retaliator (Legendary Shield)

Warden:

Band of Nature (Unique ring)
Pain Bolts (Unique Arrow)
Stormdweller Hood (Legendary Helm)

Warlock:

Brimstone Staff (Legendary Staff)
Death's List (Legendary Accessory)
Lich's Touch (Legendary Accessory)
Hellstone Amulet (Legendary Amulet)
Pestilence (Legendary Ring)
Note: Warlock got some extra love this update due to having less legendary items with effects than the other classes (now everyone has the same amount)


The following items have had their descriptions updated to be more clear:

Boots of Hermes
Nimble Boots


Set item and set bonus changes:

Templar:

Wargod:

3-piece bonus now deal a minumum of 1 second's worth of damage if the burn has less than 1 second left


Warden:

Armor of the Wispmother: 

3-piece bonus now grants 200% additional damage (up from 100%)
4-piece bonus now grants 3 additional permanent Wisps (instead of proc rate)
Wismother's Bow now rolls effect duration instead of mana on hit by default


Warlock:

Burning Hells: 

4-piece bonus now has Flaming Hells duration increased by 6 seconds, down from 10



Loot:

Improved visuals of rare loot so that the different rarities are more distinguishable
All items now display sell value on mouseover
Weapons now display damage and attackspeed on mouseover
Stack sizes increased to 1000 from 100 for potions, keys, etc.
Tweaked drop rates of rare crafting materials
Loot behind walls can now be shown as a colored dot, enable this in the gameplay options
Special items like Ancient Coins now show up properly on the "inspect nearby" feature

Misc:

Added a slight delay to the spawn buttons pop up and added cutscene bars to the death to further emphasize it, and to prevent misclicks
Changed some menu button labels

Monsters:

All monsters can now be slowed, but the previously immune monsters are capped at 10% slowed, so that effects depending on slows are properly applied
Added a new "Gem Hoarder" affix

Music:

Setting music frequency to anything other than "loop" will now fade out music when changing zones, and start the music slowly after a timer. (rather than always force start it at entry, making it basically loop anyway)
Music always fades on changing zones now, rather than cutting abruptly
Boss music always starts right away regardless of music frequency setting

Shrines:

Increased chance to get the bad shrine effect for the first time, after which the chance is drastically reduced
Removed some shrine effects from shrines inside anomalies
Added 4 new shrine effects

Skills:

Note: Mastery scaling has been adjusted to promote more versatility in your builds.
 
This means that, among other things, all passive skills now have caps on their Mastery damage increases, in order to keep their intended role as damage aplification, rather than the main source of it.
Active skills remain uncapped.
Many Mastery skills now also have a higher cap and higher damage per point, to make some previously inferior builds more evenly balanced.
Expect more skill changes, and many new item powers to change things up, in the future!

Berserker:

Rage Release:

Range increased to 3/3.5/4 meters, up from 2.2/2.4/2.6 meters

Power Within:

Overpower buff reduced to 4/8/12%, down from 5/10/15%

Frost Shock (M):

Max rank increased to 100, up from 20

High Pressure (M):

Max rank increased to 50, up from 20

Biting Cold (M):

Max rank set to 100, and damage per point increased to 5%, up from 3%

Fierce Soul (M):

Max rank set to 100, and damage per point increased to 5%, up from 3%

Tremors (M):

Max rank set to 100, and damage per point increased to 5%, up from 3%

Total Annihilaiton (M):

Max rank set to 100, and damage per point increased to 5%, up from 3%

Overpower (M):

Value per point reduced to 1%, down from 2%


Templar:

Dancing Blade:

Will now interrupt their flailing if their target dies, and find a new target

Reprisal:

Use effect now increases Thorns% by 90/105/120/135/150%, up from 5/10/15/20/25% - additively with other bonuses

Sanctified:

Now grants a minimum of 1 Health on Hit per rank. Health on Hit (lvl 100) reduced to 20/30/40, down from 25/40/55

Favor:

Now grants a minimum of 1 Mana on Hit per rank. Mana on Hit (lvl 100) reduced to 20/30/40, down from 25/40/55

Sacred (M):

Max rank increased to 100, up from 20, but damage reduced to 5% per rank, down from 10%

Empowered Expulsion (M):

Max rank increased to 100, up from 20

Electrocution (M):

Max rank increased to 100, up form 20, but damage reduced to 5% per rank, down from 10%

Thundering Wrath (M):

Max rank set to 100

Intensive Conviction (M):

Max rank increased to 100, up from 20

Pain of The Condemned (M):

Max rank set to 100, and damage per point increased to 5%, up from 3%

Iron Maiden (M):

Max rank increased to 50, up from 20, and damage increased to 5% per rank, up from 2%

Deep Cuts (M):

Max rank increased to 50, up from 20

Overpower (M):

Value per point reduced to 1%, down from 2%

Ayeela's Presence (M):

Health on Hit reduced to 4 per rank, down from 5 per rank


Warden:

Agility:

Now increases Agility by 4/8/12%, down from 10/15/20%

Move With The Wind:

Now increases Evasion by 4/6/8%, down from 6/8/10%

Winterbringer:

Now increases Evasion by 15%, down from 25%

Wisps:

Wisps are now permanent companions and limited to 3 (increased with set bonus)

Empowered Wisps:

Now adds stacks of "Empowered Wisp" on hit with Lightning spells, rapidly increasing the damage of all wisps

Siphon Energy:

Now grants a minimum of +1 mana per rank, as it would not increase on low levels earlier due to the stat growth formula

Storm Force:

Overpower buff reduced to 4/7/10%, down from 9/12/15%

Razor Cuts (M):

Max rank set to 100

Nature's Reclamation (M):

Max rank set to 100

Charged Lightning (M):

Max rank increased to 100, up from 20, but damage reduced to 5% per rank, down from 10%

Wisp Mother (M):

Max rank set to 100

Snow Storm (M):

Max rank set to 100

Overpower (M):

Value per point reduced to 1%, down from 2%


Warlock:

Masochism:

Now also triggers on self-inflicted damage from Blood Rite and Soul Trap

Vampire Lord:

Overpower buff reduced to 20%, down from 30%

Vampirism:

Now grants a minimum of 1 Health on Hit per rank. Health on Hit (lvl 100) reduced to 20/30/40, down from 34/51/68

Blast Wave (M):

Max rank increased to 100, up from 20

Burning Hells (M):

Max rank set to 100

Freezing Death (M):

Max rank set to 100

Infectious Disease (M):

Max rank set to 100

Sorrow (M):

Max rank set to 100

Dark Lust (M):

Max rank increased to 20, up from 10

Overpower (M):

Value per point reduced to 1%, down from 2%



Stats:

Overpower is now more useful as enemies will start stacking base resistances
With this in mind, the Overpower stat has been made more valuable and all skills and items now give smaller Overpower values
Health on Hit and Mana on Hit has also been made slightly more valuable in the same manner

Unstable Dimenions:

Added some new affixes
Adjusted layouts to create less dead ends and removed all disconnected platforms

Fixes:

Fixed some skill spelling errors
Fixed holding left trigger to buy 10x on controller also swapping inventory pages
Fixed Blood Rite not dealing damage to the Warlock
Fixed being able to dupe items in the Gemcutting interface
Fixed issue with items having old (useless) enchants, adding a ton of value to items and making steep enchanting costs
Fixed backspace erasing 2 letters at a time when naming your character
Fixed players using gamepads not being able to equip items from the context menu in multiplayer
Fixed players 2-4 not correctly being able to control the gem interface in multiplayer
Fixed the boss spawn in Anomalies not killing all nearby foes in some situations
Fixed rare crash from Anomaly Boss "Bramblebranch"
Fixed the last played difficulty resetting to Normal under certain circumstances in the hero select screen
Fixed dropdown buttons in menus selecting the top option when clicking outside or at the top of it
Fixed the bad shrine effect happening in Anomalies
Fixed being able to "reset" the cancel button in the waypoint menu, attempting to load an undefined zone resulting in a crash or freeze
Fixed Shrine icons remaining on the map after use when having the Challenger set
Fixed issue with a color shift in the fade out of the loading screens
Fixed issue in menus where you could in some instances select two saves at once
Fixed resurrections costing much more crystals than listed
Fixed being able to resurrect even if you didn't afford it
Fixed Warden always having a minimum of 1+ Mana on Hit
Fixed super high crystal costs being displayed for enchant scrambles while using gamepad
Fixed issue causing Soul Essence to drop in quantities lower than 1, resulting in no drops generated until a certain MF threshold was reached
Fixed dead companions teleporting to the player when outside of the view
Fixed dead companions appearing on portals after loadscreens
Fixed rounding issue with the Templar's "Vengeance" skill tree base skill and Thorns
Fixed issue causing monsters to sometimes keep moving after death
Fixed crash when loot was dropping from an unreachable point
Fixed crash on gamble & loot drops when there wasn't an eligible item in the rolled rarity to generate
Fixed monsters spawning too close to entry in Anomalies
Fixed monsters near the portal being removed on each re-enter of an Anomaly
Fixed Hidden Cellar monsters spawning outside of the room
Fixed being able to teleport out of the Hidden Cellar and locking up the quest
Fixed issue with Templar's Condemnation not always triggering
Fixed Templar's Condemnation in some instances triggering twice
Fixed Storm Mender's heals being incorrect (it was casting a Templar healing spell for whatever reason)
Fixed an issue causing barriers to visually remain after the buffs faded (this seems resilient so do let me know if they keep staying after this update)
Fixed several issues with caves and forest areas sometimes spawning portals and other objects incorrectly
Fixed issue that made it possible to "use" Ancient Coin and the Treasury Key in the inventory, deleting them from your inventory
Fixed pixies in the Mysterious Garden not dealing damage
Fixed rare crash from Templar skill Thunder Blade
Fixed some enchant's roll ranges being higher than augment cap
Fixed getting stuck in trees in Act 2 when using several Berserker jump skills (such as Leap and Hop)
Fixed Aura skills "Use" effect being cast twice
Fixed missing tiles on Eastern Wall minimap

notes.title: Windows 10 Creators Update issues!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's been brought to my attention that if you have the Windows 10 Creators Update, the game will just turn into a black screen.

Luckily, this can easily be fixed by running the game in compatibility mode for Windows 7!

If you don't know how to do  this, here's a quick guide:

[olist]
Right click Chronicon in your Steam library
Select "Properties"
Go into the "Local Files" tab
Click "Browse Local Files"
Right-click Chronicon.exe
Select "Properties"
Click the "Compatibility" tab
Check "Run in compatibility mode for"
Select Windows 7 in the drop-down list
Hit accept and run the game!
[/olist]


Meanwhile I'll try to figure out why this happens.
Thanks!
